blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) decoders reconstruct images and 3D objects, recovering the metric geometry of rooms from a moving viewpoint remains an open challenge. We introduce, to our knowledge for the first time, the task of reconstructing 3D layouts of held-out scenes using only the known camera trajectories and the fMRI signals of participants watching indoor walkthroughs, without any visual frames. The task is hard because of the temporal mismatch between rapid visual changes and blurred fMRI signals. Our method, DRAFT (Decoding and Reconstructing 3D room lAyouts from fMRI and Trajectories), extracts a compact layout representation from the early visual cortex and fuses this neural code with the geometric free space derived from camera motion. To evaluate it, we propose layout r, the Pearson correlation between predicted and ray-cast log depths. On ten held-out scenes (20 participants), DRAFT reaches a layout r of 0.480, outperforming the camera path alone (0.446) and seven fMRI decoders (at most 0.429). DRAFT also works as a plug-in that improves all seven decoders without retraining, raising their layout r from 0.171-0.429 to 0.487-0.493. Brain activity and camera motion can thus recover the metric layout of unseen rooms, a first step toward reconstructing the 3D spaces people see.
blocks.zh: 虽然功能磁共振成像(fMRI)解码器重建图像和3D物体,但从移动的角度恢复房间的几何特征仍然是一个公开的挑战。 我们第一次向我们介绍,我们的任务是重建被搁置的场景的3D布局,只使用已知的相机轨迹和参与者观看室内行走的fMRI信号,没有任何视觉框架. 由于快速视觉变化和模糊的fMRI信号之间的时间不匹配,任务很困难. 我们的方法,Draft(从fMRI和轨迹提取一个紧凑的布局表示,并用相机运动产生的几何自由空间来引导这个神经编码。 为了评价它,我们提出布局r, 皮尔逊关联 预测和射线广播的日志深度。 在10场被搁置的场景(20名与会者)中,Draft达到了0.480的布局r,单是镜头路径(0.446)和7个fMRI解码器(最多0.429)。 草案还起到插件的作用,在不进行再培训的情况下改进所有7个解码器,将其版式r从0.171-0.429提高到0.487-0.493. 因此,大脑活动和摄像头运动可以恢复看不见的房间的度量布局,这是重建人们看到的3D空间的第一步。

blocks.en:
Reconstructing a room needs more than a plausible picture. Walls must sit at the right distances, and views taken from different places must describe the same space.
Decoders of functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) now reconstruct images and videos ( Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023 ; Scotti et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2023b ) , depth images ( Gaziv & Irani, 2021 ; Xia et al., 2024 ) and isolated 3D objects ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , yet to our knowledge none has recovered metric room geometry as the viewpoint moves.
We ask whether fMRI responses to indoor walkthrough videos support layout and surface reconstruction in scenes the model has never seen.
blocks.zh:
重建一个房间需要的不只是一个可信的图片。 墙壁必须坐落在正确的距离上,从不同地点获得的观点必须描述同样的空间.
功能磁共振成像的解码器(fMRI)现在重建图像和视频(Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023年;Scotti等人, 2024年;Chen等人, 2023年b),深度图像 (Gaziv & Irani, 2021; Xia等人, 2024年)和隔离的3D物体(Gao等人, 2024年),然而据我们所知,没有一个物体随着视线移动而恢复了测量室几何学。
我们询问fMRI是否对室内穿行视频做出回应,

blocks.en:
This is hard for three reasons. The viewpoint changes every second, the blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) signal of fMRI blurs several seconds together, and recordings are few.
So we do not decode depth maps directly. We decode a small layout code, 22 numbers per second that describe wall distances, floor extent, openings and depth range.
Ridge regressions, the readout, predict it from early visual cortex (EVC) and camera motion. EVC responses map the image point by point, so they carry image structure that correlates with depth. Scene-selective regions also respond to room layout ( Section 2 ), but in our data EVC predicted the code better ( Section 5.2 ).
The camera path also helps. Every visited position is free space, just as steps through a dark room show where the walls are not. We use it as a learned prior, not a bound on wall distance.
blocks.zh:
难此三因. 观点每秒变化一次,fMRI的血氧水平依赖(BOLD)信号会模糊几秒,录音也很少.
所以我们不直接解码深度图。 我们解码一个小版面代码,每秒22个数字,用来描述墙壁距离,地板范围,开口和深度范围.
岭回归,读出,从早期视觉皮层(EVC)和相机运动中预测. EVC响应逐点映射图像点,因此它们带有与深度相连的图像结构. 场景选择区域也响应房间布局(第2节),但在我们的数据中EVC预言了更好的代码(第5.2节).
相机路径也有帮助. 每个被访问的位置都是自由的空间,就像穿过黑暗的房间秀,墙没有。 我们把它当作一个经验 之前,而不是在墙的距离。

blocks.en:
Our method DRAFT ( Figure 2 ) combines both and, like an architect’s draft, fixes the coarse layout first and the details later.
It renders the code as coarse depth, and a small generator trained on real readout errors adds detail to eight consecutive views. DRAFT then replaces the broad structure (low spatial frequencies) of the views with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 DRAFT layout, predicted from the code and the camera path, and places the views in 3D at the known poses.
blocks.zh:
我们的方法草案(图2)结合了两者,并且像建筑师的草案一样,首先确定粗糙的布局,然后确定细节。
它使代码成为粗深,一个接受过真实读出错误训练的小型生成器为连续八个视图增加了细节. 草案然后将视图的宽结构(低空间频率)替换为从代码和相机路径预言的3×3 3~times}3 草案布局,并将视图以3D形式放置在已知的姿势上.

blocks.en:
Across ten held-out scenes, the DRAFT layout’s cell depths correlate with the true ones at 0.480 (layout r r , Section 5.1 ). This is above the best of seven adapted fMRI decoders (0.429), the fixed template (median training-scene depth, 0.324) and the generator alone (0.303).
Most of this comes from the camera path (0.446), but the brain adds to it. Adding the readout to the camera path raises layout r r in all ten scenes, and brain-input controls lower it in all ten ( Section 5.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在10个被搁置的场景中,布局草案的单元格深度与真实的深度0.480相关(layout r,第5.1节)。 这高于7个经过改造的fMRI解码器(0.429),固定模板(中间训练-场景深度,0.324)和仅发电机(0.303)中最好的.
这大多来自相机路径(0.446),但脑部增加了. 将读出内容添加到相机路径会提高所有十个场景的布局r r,大脑输入控制将其降低到所有十个场景(第5.2节.

blocks.en:
The 3D surfaces tell a weaker story ( Section 5.4 ). Because ridge regressions shrink the depth range, DRAFT ends with a range calibration, whose factor we fixed after earlier results on the same scenes.
Even so, unmodified MindEye and Brain-Diffuser have slightly better mean surface scores, and so does the generator alone with a milder calibration.
Guided by the DRAFT layout, these two image decoders reach the best fMRI-based mean surface scores, within noise of their unmodified versions.
blocks.zh:
3D表面讲述了一个较弱的故事(第5.4节). 因为山脊反射缩小了深度范围,所以Arror以测距校准结束,我们在同一场景中经过早先的结果后固定了它的因子.
即便如此,未经修改的MindEye和Brain-Diffuser的表面分数也略好一些,而仅用更温和的校准的发电机也是这样.
在Draft布局的指引下,这两个图像解码器在其未经修改的版本的噪声中达到了基于fMRI的最好的平均表面分数.

blocks.en: We contribute a readout of a layout code from EVC and camera motion, and the DRAFT layout, which fuses this code with the camera path and raises the layout r r of all seven tested decoders without retraining (five post hoc). We also contribute a held-out-scene test of room geometry from fMRI, with ray-cast ground truth, fMRI-free and wrong-scene references and brain-input controls.
blocks.zh: 我们提供一个从EVC和相机运动读取的布局代码,以及Draft布局,将这个代码与相机路径连接起来,提高所有七个测试解码器的布局rr,而不进行再培训(五个后临时). 我们还对来自fMRI的房间几何学进行预留式测试,包括射线播报的地面真实性、fMRI的无误场参照以及脑输入控制。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
fMRI decoding reconstructs movies ( Nishimoto et al., 2011 ) and images ( Shen et al., 2019 ) through learned feature mappings ( Kay et al., 2008 ; Naselaris et al., 2011 ) .
The Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) ( Allen et al., 2022 ) supports diffusion-based image decoding ( Takagi & Nishimoto, 2023a ; Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023 ; Scotti et al., 2023 ; Scotti et al., 2024 ) . MinD-Vis adds brain pretraining and MinD-Video extends it to video ( Chen et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2023b ) . Gaziv & Irani (2021) reconstruct depth and color images with monocular-depth supervision, and DREAM decodes depth, color and semantics for image reconstruction ( Xia et al., 2024 ) .
We instead test metric layout in held-out scenes against ray-cast geometry.
blocks.zh:
fMRI解码重建电影(Nishimoto等人,2011年)和图像(Shen等人,2019年)通过学习的特征绘图(Kay等人,2008年;Naselaris等人,2011年).
Natural Scenes Dataset(NSD)(Allen等人,2022年)支持基于扩散的图像解码(Takagi & Nishimoto,2023a;Ozcelik & VanRullen,2023年;Scotti等人,2023年;Scotti等人,2024年). MinD-Vis增加了大脑预训,MinD-Video将其扩展至视频(Chen等人,2023a; Chen et al., 2023b ). Gaziv & Irani (2021) 重建深度和颜色图像,进行单体深度监督,DREAM解码深度,颜色和语义,用于图像重建(Xia et al., 2024).
相反,我们测试了在被搁置的场景中的度量布局 对照射线几何。

blocks.en:
MinD-3D reconstructs object meshes from fMRI of rotating objects ( Gao et al., 2024 ) , and Neuro-3D reconstructs colored object point clouds from electroencephalography (EEG) ( Guo et al., 2025 ) . Closest to our setting, Zeng & Cai (2024) decode the depth structure of first-person driving videos in a held-out virtual town by matching decoded embeddings to those of the town’s own scenes. DRAFT instead predicts metric depth without the held-out scene’s geometry and lifts it to 3D surfaces.
Scene-selective regions respond to spatial layout ( Epstein & Kanwisher, 1998 ; Dilks et al., 2013 ; Henriksson et al., 2019 ) , boundaries ( Park et al., 2011 ; Julian et al., 2016 ) , navigational affordances ( Bonner & Epstein, 2017 ) and 3D surface configuration ( Lescroart & Gallant, 2019 ) , and support the cognitive map ( Epstein et al., 2017 ) .
For static photographs, Gabor-wavelet features predict their responses better than explicit surface models ( Shafer-Skelton et al., 2026 ) , and our readout also cannot separate depth from correlated image features.
blocks.zh:
MinD-3D从旋转对象的fMRI(Gao等人,2024年)重建对象中间点,Neuro-3D从电脑学(EEG)重建有色对象点云(Guo等人,2025年). 最接近我们的设定, Zeng & Cai (2024) 解码了第一人称驾驶视频的深度结构, 相反,草案预测了没有被搁置场景几何的测量深度,并将其提升到立体表面。
场景选择区对空间布局的反应(Epstein & Kanwisher,1998年;Dilks等人,2013年;Henriksson等人,2019年),边界 (Park et al.,2011年;Julian et al.,2016年),航海支付能力(Bonner & Epstein,2017年)和3D表面配置(Lescroart & Gallant,2019年),并支持认知地图(Epstein et al.,2017年).
对于静态照片,Gabor-wablet特性预测其反应优于清晰的表面模型(Shafer-Skelton等人,2026年),我们的读取也无法将深度与相关图像特性区分开来.

blocks.en:
Monocular depth models ( Eigen et al., 2014 ; Ranftl et al., 2022 ; Ranftl et al., 2021 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Yang et al., 2024b ; Bochkovskii et al., 2025 ; Ke et al., 2024 ) now learn from large mixed datasets and diffusion priors.
Replacing low spatial frequencies resembles low-frequency guidance of diffusion models ( Choi et al., 2021 ) and spatial control of pretrained generators ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) . Our replacement acts on output depth without training, so any decoder can supply the detail. The camera path as a free-space prior relates to occupancy mapping ( Elfes, 1989 ) and trajectory-based free-space prediction ( Wijmans et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
单体深度模型(Eigen等人,2014年;Ranftl等人,2022年;Ranftl等人,2021年;Yang等人,2024年a;Yang等人,2024年b;Bochkovskii等人,2025年;Ke等人,2024年)现在学习大型混合数据集和传播前科.
取代低空间频率类似于对扩散模型的低频率引导(Choi 等人,2021年)和对预训发电机的空间控制(Zhang 等人,2023年). 我们的替换在输出深度上不经过训练,所以任何解码器都可以提供细节. 相机路径作为空闲空间前,涉及占用绘图(Elfes,1989年)和基于轨迹的自由空间预测(Wijmans等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: 3 Task, Data and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 任务、数据和评价

blocks.en:
A participant watches a first-person walkthrough video of a furnished indoor scene during fMRI.
We split each video into routes of eight consecutive one-second views. For each route, the model predicts eight depth maps and the 3D surface they form. Its inputs are the brain responses and the camera path (position, heading and pitch in each second), never the video frames.
blocks.zh:
一名与会者观看了FMRI期间室内室内布置的第一人行走录像。
我们把每段视频 分成连续八次观看的路线 对于每一条路线,模型预测了8张深度图以及它们形成的3D表面. 它的投入是大脑反应和相机路径(位置,方向和投球每秒),从不播放视频帧.

blocks.en:
Twenty participants, 6 to 19 per scene, watched 80-second videos of ten furnished indoor scenes ( Table 4 ). Each scene was rendered in up to four interior styles that share the floor plan and a similar camera path but differ in materials, colors and furniture.
This gives 36 videos and 416 recordings (one participant watching one video). Each recording has 74 one-second samples, because the last six seconds are left for the response delay. Viewing was free, with no fixation task or eye tracking, and the same participants appear in training and held-out scenes.
Ground-truth radial depth (distance along each camera ray) is ray-cast from the 3D scene models at the recorded poses (90° horizontal field of view, 48 × 64 48\times 64 pixels). Nine non-overlapping routes per video give 324 routes.
Nuisance regression and z-scoring use whole scanner runs, which can mix training and held-out scenes but never a depth target ( Section A.1 ).
blocks.zh:
20名与会者,每场6至19人,观看了80秒的10个室内装修场景的录像(表4)。 每个场景都采用最多四种内部风格,共用地板图和类似的相机路径,但材料、颜色和家具不同。
这提供了36个视频和416个录音(一名与会者观看了一个视频)。 每段录音有74个1秒的样本,因为最后6秒留给反应延迟. 观看是免费的,没有固定任务或眼睛跟踪,同样的参与者出现在培训和被搁置的场景中.
地面-真实射线深度(沿着每条相机射线的距离)是从记录的姿势上的3D场景模型(90°水平视场,48×64 48\time64像素)进行的射线广播. 每条视频有9条非重叠路线,可提供324条路线。
Nuisance回归和z评分使用全扫描仪运行,可以混合培训和被搁置的场景,但绝不是深度目标(A.1节).

blocks.en:
We use leave-one-scene-out cross-validation over the ten scenes. Every model behind a test prediction is fitted without any style, recording or route of the held-out scene.
Models that take other models’ predictions as input are fitted on out-of-fold predictions: for each training scene, models fitted without that scene predict it ( Section A.2 ).
At test time, predictions are averaged over the recordings of the held-out video and over another style at matching poses, without depth labels ( Section 4.1 ). So results use pooled recordings, not single trials or single participants.
blocks.zh:
我们用一幕片段进行交叉验证 测试预测背后的每一个模型都是安装的,没有任何风格,录音或被搁置场景的路线.
将其他模型的预测作为投入的模型安装在外侧预测上:对于每个培训场景,没有该场景的模型都安装在外侧预测上(A.2节)。
在测试时,对被搁置的视频的录音和对姿势的另一种样式进行平均预测,没有深度标签(第4.1节)。 因此,结果使用集合录音,而不是单一审判或单一参与者.

blocks.en: We adapt seven fMRI decoders to our folds. Five are published: image and depth decoding ( Takagi & Nishimoto, 2023a ; Takagi & Nishimoto, 2023b ) , the DREAM depth branch ( Xia et al., 2024 ) , Brain-Diffuser ( Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023 ) and MindEye ( Scotti et al., 2023 ) . Two are simple ridge decoders: linear depth decoding and retrieval of CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) image embeddings ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , like the retrieval branch of MindEye. The published decoders keep their released components and original brain regions. Depth Anything V2 (DA V2) ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , with its scale calibrated on the training scenes, turns decoded images into radial depth. The decoders may read scene-selective regions and use large pretrained models, but they see no camera input and decode each view separately. Trained on nine scenes, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye identify the viewed frame only weakly ( Appendix C ). We also use two fMRI-free references. The fixed template is the median training-scene depth, and the per-second median is this median taken separately at each video second ( Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 我们调整了7个fMRI解码器来适应我们的折叠. 五篇发表:图像和深度解码(高木和西本,2023a;高木和西本,2023b),梦幻号深度分支(霞等人,2024),Brain-Diffuser(Ozcelik & VanRullen,2023)和MindEye(斯科特等人,2023). 二是简单的山脊解码器:线性深度解码和检索CLIP(Contrestive Language-Image Pre-training)图像嵌入(Radford et al., 2021),如MindEye的检索分支. 已出版的解码器保留其释放的组件和原脑区域. 深度Anything V2(DA V2)(Yang等人,2024年b),其尺度在训练场景上校准,将解码的图像变成射线深度. 解码器可能读取场景选择区域,并使用大型的预先训练的模型,但他们看不到相机输入,并且将每个视图分别解码. 在9场景上接受训练,Brain-Diffuser和MindEye只辨别了观看的帧(附录C). 我们也使用两个fMRI无引用. 固定模板是训练-场景深度的中位数,每秒中位数是每个视频秒分别取用的这个中位数(附录G.

blocks.en:
Our main metric, layout r r , asks whether a prediction knows which parts of a view are near or far. It is the Pearson correlation between the predicted and true median log depths of the nine cells of a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 grid over the view. Row order is the fraction of correctly ordered cell pairs in the same row, and left/right the fraction of views whose deeper half is identified. Pixel MAE (mean absolute error) is the depth error in meters over valid pixels. All four are averaged over the 324 routes ( Section B.1 ).
For surfaces, we back-project each view along its camera rays at the known pose. The eight views of a route then merge on 5 cm voxels into one point set, the surface, without extracting a mesh. We compare it with the ground-truth points visible from the same poses, not with the whole room mesh.
The F-score (F@25cm) is the harmonic mean of precision , the fraction of predicted points within 25 cm of a true point, and recall , the fraction of true points within 25 cm of a predicted point. The Chamfer distance averages the nearest-point distances in both directions, in meters.
Surface metrics and paired contrasts weight scenes equally, with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) from 20,000 paired scene-bootstrap resamples and the number of scenes that favor each method. Intervals are not corrected for multiple comparisons and can be too narrow, as scenes share participants and some scanner runs. So four main layout contrasts, named after the results were known, also get sign-flip p p values with Holm correction. Some other contrasts get uncorrected p p values. An interval that includes zero does not prove two methods equal ( Appendix B ).
blocks.zh:
我们的主要衡量标准,布局r r, 问一个预测是否知道视图的哪些部分是近还是远. 这是Pearson在视图上3×3 3⁄3格数的9个细胞的预测和真实中位日志深度之间的关联。 行顺序是同一行中正确排列的单元格对的分数,左/右是其更深半部分被识别的视图的分数. 像素MAE(意为绝对错误)是有效像素之上的米深误差. 这四条路线均在324条路线上(B.1节)。
对于表面,我们背面投影 沿它的相机射线 已知的姿势。 一个路线的八景然后在5cm voxels上合并成一个点集,即表面,而不提取网格. 我们把它与同一姿势所可见的地面真相点进行比较,而不是与整个房间的网状点进行比较。
F-分数(F@25cm)是精度的谐音平均值,是某一真实点25cm范围内的预测点数的分数,并且回忆,是某一预测点25cm范围内的真实点数的分数. 钱弗尔距离平均为两个方向的最近点距离,以米计.
表面度量和对齐对比的重量场景是相等的,95%的置信间隔(CIs)来自20,000对对齐的场景-bootstrap resamples,以及赞成每种方法的场景数量. 间距不为多重比较而纠正,可能过于狭窄,因为场景共享参与者和一些扫描仪运行. 因此以结果已知命名的四大布局对比,也得到了Holm校正的标志-flip p值. 其他一些对比得到未修正的p值. 包含零的间隔不能证明两种方法相等(附录B )。

blocks.en: Six ridge regressions map EVC responses and 12 camera-motion regressors to the code 𝒚 {\bm{y}} , standardized on the training scenes. They differ in voxel count, ridge penalty and response window, and their mean is the readout 𝒚 ^ t \hat{\bm{y}}_{t} ( Equation 5 ). EVC comprises V1, V2, ventral V3 (V3v) and human V4 (hV4), whose most reliable voxels are reduced to 16 principal components. The regressors are a constant, speed and turning speed at lags of 0 to 4 s, and a linear trend. The regressions are fitted to participant-averaged responses of the nine training scenes and applied to each held-out recording.

blocks.en: One recording is noisy, and other styles of a scene often pass the same poses. So each second we average the readout of the evaluated recording with the participant-averaged readout of at most one other style, weighted by recording counts. Pooling never uses depth labels or pairs different seconds, but furniture may differ across styles ( Section A.3 ). The pooled readout of each code entry j j is its posterior mean μ j \mu_{j} . Because readout reliability varies, each entry also gets a posterior spread s j s_{j} , its out-of-fold residual standard deviation ( Section A.2 ). Together they form a point estimate with an error bar, not a full Bayesian posterior.
blocks.zh: 一个录音很吵,一个场景的其他风格经常通过相同的姿势. 因此,每秒我们平均读出 评估的录音 与参与者平均读出 最多一种其他风格, 加权记录计数。 Pooling从不使用深度标签或不同的对秒,但家具可能因风格不同而不同(A.3节). 每个代码条目j j 的集合读取是它的后缀 μ j\mu_{j} 。 由于读出可靠性各有不同,每个条目还获得一个后扩散s j s_{j},即其外溢的剩余标准偏差(A.2节). 它们共同构成一个点估计值和一个错误栏,而不是一个完整的贝叶斯后缀.

blocks.en: 5.1 Layout accuracy
blocks.zh: 5.1 布局精确度

blocks.en: The DRAFT layout is more accurate than every fMRI decoder that does not use it, even with the camera path. Its layout r r is higher than that of linear depth in seven scenes and of MindEye and Brain-Diffuser in all ten (no sign-flip test, Table 5 ). Unlike these decoders, the fusion head is fitted to the cell depths that layout r r scores. Given the camera path through the trajectory layout, each decoder still trails DRAFT by 0.024 to 0.032 (ten-scene means). It trails in eight to ten scenes (sign-flip p ≤ 0.010 p\leq 0.010 ), and this comparison is post hoc for five decoders ( Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: Draft版式比每个不使用它的fMRI解码器更准确,即使有相机路径. 它的布局r r 高于七个场景中的线性深度,以及MindEye和Brain-Diffuser在所有十个场景中的布局(没有标志-flip测试,表5 ). 与这些解码器不同,核聚变头被安装在布局r r 分数的细胞深度上. 考虑到通过轨迹布局的相机路径,每个解码器仍会按0.024至0.032(十幕表示)跟踪Draft. 它在8到10个场景中出现(符号-flip p ≤ 0.010 p\leq 0.010 ),这个比较是五个解码器的特设(表5).

blocks.en: The gain is more than a good guess about indoor rooms. Indoor views share a common shape, floor near and walls farther away, so a template gets part of the layout right. The DRAFT layout beats the fixed template in nine scenes and the per-second median (layout r r 0.241) in all ten. Brain-Diffuser, MindEye and the generator alone do not beat the fixed template ( Figure 4 e).

blocks.en: 5.2 Camera path and brain contributions
blocks.zh: 5.2 相机路径和大脑贡献

blocks.en: The camera path gives most of the layout, and the brain adds to it in every scene. From the camera path alone, the trajectory head reaches a layout r r of 0.446 ( Table 1 ). To score the readout by layout r r directly, we also fit it to the 3 × 3 3{\times}3 cell depths. Adding EVC to its 12 camera-motion regressors raises layout r r from 0.338 to 0.440 in nine scenes ( Table 3 ). Fusing the code with the trajectory layout raises layout r r by 0.035 in all ten scenes and lowers pixel MAE in nine.
blocks.zh: 相机路径给出了大部分布局,大脑在每个场景中都加入了其中. 仅从相机路径,轨迹头部达到0.446r的布局(表1)。 为了直接通过 r 的布局来评分读出, 我们还把它配到 3× 3 3 的细胞深度 3 。 将EVC添加到它的12个相机运动反射器上,将r r的布局从0.338提高到0.440的9场景(表3 ). 以轨迹布局来使用代码将所有十个场景的布局r r 提升 0.035 ,并在 9 中降低像素 MAE.

blocks.en:
Two brain-input controls separate the brain’s gain from camera motion. Because the readout also uses camera-motion regressors, the fusion gain does not isolate the brain. Both controls keep these regressors and lower the layout r r and F-score of DRAFT in all ten scenes.
Replacing the EVC features (16 principal-component scores) with their training-scene mean (replaced EVC) lowers them by 0.037 and 0.036 ( Section D.3 ).
Circularly shifting each recording’s BOLD series by 37 of 80 seconds (shifted BOLD) and refitting the readout lowers them by 0.043 and 0.044 (one fixed shift, not a permutation test, Section D.4 ). At the readout level, the EVC gain peaks at a lag of 3 to 4 s and beats all 20 circular shifts ( Section D.2 ). Post hoc, the brain’s gain persists in single recordings (0.012, eight scenes) and in all 300 tested pipeline settings. It is no larger where the path covers less of the view, and more recordings would add only about 0.002 ( Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
两个脑输入控制将大脑的收益从相机运动中分离出来. 由于读取器也使用相机运动回转器,聚变增益不会将大脑隔离. 两种控件都保留这些退步器,并降低所有十个场景中Draft的r和F分数的布局.
以培训场面平均值(替换的EVC)取代EVC特征(16个主要组成部分分数),将其降低0.037和0.036(D.3节)。
循环将每个录制的BOLD系列移动37秒80(转换BOLD),并重新调整读出,使其降低0.043和0.044(一个固定班次,而不是变换测试,D.4节)。 在读取水平上,EVC以3比4 s的落后速度获得峰值,并击败所有20个循环班次(D.2节. 之后,大脑的收益持续在单声道(0.012,八幕)和所有300个经过测试的管道设置中。 当路面覆盖的视野较少时,情况并不大,更多的录音只会增加约0.002(附录一)。

blocks.en:
EVC predicts the code best among the tested regions. With 1,000 voxels per mask and the camera-motion regressors, EVC predicts the code better than motion alone in all ten scenes. It also beats the scene-selective occipital place area (OPA), parahippocampal place area (PPA) and retrosplenial complex (RSC) together in nine ( Figure 3 , Section D.2 ).
Without functional localizers or dorsal motion areas, this only ranks the masks and shows no biological cause.
blocks.zh:
EVC在测试区域中预测代码最好. EVC用每面罩1000伏克塞尔和相机运动递减器来预测,在所有十个场景中,代码比单动作要好. 它还将场景选择性卵巢区(OPA),伞兵营区(PPA)和复方综合体(RSC)合为九(图3,D.2节)。
没有功能定位器或家畜运动区,这只将口罩排在首位,没有生物原因.

blocks.en: 5.3 Guiding other decoders and agreement across views
blocks.zh: 5.3 指导其他解码器和各种观点的一致

blocks.en: Other decoders inherit the DRAFT layout. All seven decoders score best with it in all three metrics of Table 2 , with a 95% CI excluding zero in 17 of 21 cases, all but the surfaces of Brain-Diffuser and MindEye. For Brain-Diffuser, it raises layout r r from 0.324 to 0.493 in all ten scenes, the highest fMRI-based value. The other six reach about 0.49 (five post hoc), above their versions with the trajectory layout in all ten scenes ( Section C.2 ). Layout r r then mostly scores the DRAFT layout ( Section 4.3 ), so surfaces are the real test.
blocks.zh: 其他解码器继承了草稿布局. 所有7个解码器在表2的所有3个度量中都得分最好,其中95%的CI排除了21个病例中的17个,除Brain-Diffuser和MindEye的表面外,其余全部为0. 对于Brain-Diffuser来说,它将所有十个场景的布局r r从0.324提高到0.493,这是fMRI基值最高的. 其他6个达到约0.49(5个后临时),高于其版本,所有10个场景的轨迹布局(C.2节). 布局 r 然后大部分评分为Draft布局(第4.3节),所以表面是真正的测试.

blocks.en:
The DRAFT layout also makes the views agree. The DRAFT layout lowers the change in 3D error between views 1 s apart for every scored depth source. Yet this measure also rewards views that are wrong in the same way ( Tables 11 and F.2 ).
DRAFT views agree more than Brain-Diffuser’s with the DRAFT layout (mean change 0.63 against 0.81 m, all ten scenes, Section F.2 ). But linear depth with the same layout, also decoded view by view, agrees as well or better (0.58 m).
blocks.zh:
草案的版式也使各方意见一致。 Draft 版式降低了视图 1 s 之间的3D 错误变化。 然而,这一措施也奖励同样错误的观点(表11和F.2)。
观点草案比Brain-Diffuser更赞同草案的布局(意为将0.63改为0.81米,所有十个场景,F.2节)。 但是具有相同布局的线性深度,也通过视图解码视图,同意或更好(0.58米).

blocks.en: 5.4 Eight-view 3D surfaces
blocks.zh: 5.4 八景三维面

blocks.en:
After range calibration, the DRAFT layout costs no measurable surface accuracy. Calibration brings the cell log depths of DRAFT to 0.97 of the true spread. DRAFT has a lower Chamfer distance than the generator alone (eight scenes), a higher precision (all ten) and a similar F-score ( Table 3 ). But its Chamfer distance is not lower than the generator’s at its own selected factor (1.5, Table 15 ). The readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target, without free space, reaches a similar F-score (0.485).
Without calibration, fusion lowers the F-score of the generator alone from 0.477 to 0.416 and raises its Chamfer distance by 0.065 m in all ten scenes. The DRAFT layout also lowers the uncalibrated F-score of the three decoders with the best unmodified surfaces, because ridge heads shrink the depth range ( Tables 13 and C.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在测距校准后,草案布局没有花费可衡量的表面精确度。 校准使草案的单元格日志深度达到真实传播的0.97。 草案的Chamfer距离低于发电机本身(8个场景),精度更高(所有10个场景),F分数相似(表3)。 但它的Chamfer距离并不低于其自己选定的因数(1.5,表15)的发电机。 3×3 3 3}3 目标读取,没有空闲空间,达到类似的F分数(0.485).
没有校准,聚变将单发电机的F分数从0.477降到0.416,并在所有10场景中将其Chamfer距离提高0.065米. 草案布局还降低了三个解码器中最优的未修改表面的F分数,因为脊头缩小了深度范围(表13和C.2.

blocks.en: The calibration factor was fixed after earlier results on these scenes. Selecting the factor by F-score instead of Chamfer distance picks 2 or 2.5 and lowers the held-out F-score of DRAFT to 0.477. At their Chamfer-selected factors, DRAFT, the generator alone, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye differ in F-score by at most 0.016, the generator alone slightly ahead, within noise ( Table 15 ).
blocks.zh: 校准因子在这些场景的早期结果后被固定. 用 F 分数而不是 Chamfer 距离来选择系数 选择 2 或 2.5 , 将 草案中被搁置的 F 分数降低为 0. 477 。 在Chamfer选定系数中,Draft、Brain-Diffuser和MindEye在F分数方面最多有0.016分,仅发电机在噪音范围内略为领先(表15)。

blocks.en:
Unmodified MindEye and Brain-Diffuser reach slightly higher mean F-scores than DRAFT (0.494 and 0.492 against 0.484) and lower Chamfer distances ( Table 2 ). Only the lower Chamfer distance of MindEye holds beyond noise (nine scenes, Appendix G ).
Their detail comes from large pretrained image models, ours from a small generator trained on nine scenes. Removing our detail lowers the F-score by 0.042 in all ten scenes ( Table 3 ), but this detail is mostly one pattern shared by all scenes and correlates with the true detail at only 0.026 ( Appendix G ). So scene-specific geometry comes mainly from the DRAFT layout.
Against decoders with the trajectory layout, DRAFT is within noise of CLIP retrieval, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye in F-score. It is ahead of the other four, each in at least eight scenes (post hoc sign-flip tests, Table 5 ).
With the DRAFT layout, Brain-Diffuser’s detail raises recall over DRAFT and slightly lowers precision, in all ten scenes. This gives the best fMRI-based mean F-score (0.499), within noise of both unmodified decoders ( Appendix G ). MindEye with the DRAFT layout ties it post hoc and has the lowest Chamfer distance (0.376 m).
blocks.zh:
未修改的MindEye和Brain-Diffuser的平均F分数略高于Draft(0.494和0.492对0.484)和Chamfer距离较小(表2)。 只有MindEye的下方Chamfer距离持有超过噪音(9幕,附录G ).
他们的详情来自大型预训图像模型, 我们的来自一个小型发电机 训练了九幕。 移除细节后,所有十个场景的F分数都降低了0.042(表3),但这一细节大多是所有场景共有的图案,与真实细节相关,只有0.026(附录G). 因此场景特有的几何学主要来源于Draft布局.
针对轨迹布局的解码器,Draft在CLIP检索,Brain-Diffuser和MindEye在F分数中的噪音范围内. 它领先于其他四个,每个至少八个场景(后期标志-滑翔测试,表5).
随着草稿的布局,Brain-Diffuser的细节在所有十个场景中都提高了对草稿的回顾,并略微降低了精度。 这使得基于fMRI的最好的平均F分数(0.499)在两种未经修改的解码器(附录G)的噪声内. MindEye与Draft布局将它连接在临时位置上,并拥有最小的Chamfer距离(0.376米).

blocks.en: Surface scores separate the methods little, for two reasons. First, even a wrong scene scores well. Depth predicted for another scene and lifted at the evaluated poses (post hoc) keeps most of the F-score of DRAFT, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye. The correct scene adds only 0.055 to 0.069, in all ten scenes each ( Table 12 , Figure 4 f). Subtracting this wrong-scene score does not favor DRAFT over MindEye (post hoc, Appendix I ). Second, the scores reward depth range. DA V2 gives decoded images nearly the true range, 0.84 of the true spread against 0.46 to 0.54 for our ridge layouts ( Section C.1 ). This raises recall even for a wrong layout.
blocks.zh: 由于两个原因,表面分数很少区分方法。 首先,即使一个错误的场景 得分很好。 深度预测到另一个场景,并在被评价的姿势(后临时姿势)上升空,保持了Draft,Brain-Diffuser和MindEye的大部分F分数. 正确的场景只增加了0.055到0.069,每场10场(表12,图4f). 减去这种错误的场面分数,并不有利于Draft than MindEye(特设后,附录一)。 第二,分数奖励深度范围. DA V2给出的解码图像几乎是真实范围,真实分布的0.84对0.46到0.54对我们的山脊布局(C.1节). 这引起人们的回想起,即使是错误的布局。

blocks.en:
Once depth scale is removed, DRAFT has lower depth error than the unmodified image decoders, but this is a low bar. Scored without range calibration for every method, DRAFT has a lower scale-invariant depth error ( Eigen et al., 2014 , SI-log,) than the trajectory head, the generator, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye in all ten scenes (sign-flip p = 0.002 p=0.002 ). After post hoc median alignment of each view to the true depth, its F-score beats these four in nine or ten scenes each.
Yet Brain-Diffuser and MindEye have a higher SI-log than the fixed template (57.3 and 59.5 against 52.8, and 49.6 for DRAFT). Linear depth ties DRAFT, and Brain-Diffuser with the DRAFT layout nearly ties it in SI-log and beats it after alignment. The fixed template, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye also have more pixels within a factor of 1.25 of the true depth ( Sections F.1 and 10 ).
blocks.zh:
一旦深度尺度被移除,Draft的深度误差比未修改的图像解码器要低,但这是一个低的栏. 在所有十个场景中,Draft的分数没有范围校准,比轨迹头、发电机、Brain-Diffuser和MindEye的分数(符号-flip p = 0.002 p= 0. 在每个视图与真实深度的后临时中位数对齐后,其F分数在每场9或10场中击败这4场.
然而,Brain-Diffuser和MindEye的SI记录高于固定模板(草案57.3和59.5对52.8和49.6)。 线性深度链接 Draft 和 Brain-Diffuser 与 Draft 的布局几乎将其在 SI-log 中连接,并在对齐后击败它. 固定模板Brain-Diffuser和MindEye在真实深度的1.25系数内也有较多的像素(F.1和10节)。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: To our knowledge, DRAFT is the first method to decode from fMRI the metric layout of rooms seen from a moving viewpoint and to test it against ray-cast ground truth in held-out scenes. It reads a layout code each second from EVC and camera motion, fuses it with the camera path and turns it into depth maps and 3D surfaces. In ten held-out scenes, its layout r r is 0.480, above seven adapted fMRI decoders (at most 0.429) and the camera path alone (0.446), and brain-input controls lower it in every scene. Used as a plug-in prior without retraining, the DRAFT layout raises the layout r r of all seven decoders to about 0.49 (five post hoc) and gives Brain-Diffuser and MindEye the best fMRI-based mean surface scores. Its fMRI-free and wrong-scene references and brain-input controls separate what the camera path, the brain and pretrained image models contribute.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,Draft是从fMRI中解码从移动角度看到的房间的度量布局的第一种方法,也是在被搁置的场景中对照射线播报的地面真实性进行测试的. 它每秒从EVC和相机运动读取一个布局代码,将其与相机路径连接,并转化为深度地图和3D表面. 在十个被搁置的场景中,它的布局r为0.480,高于七个经过改造的fMRI解码器(最多为0.429),而光是相机路径(0.446),大脑输入控制在每一个场景中降低. 在不进行再培训的情况下,草案布局将所有7个解码器的布局r提升到约0.49(5个后临时),并使Brain-Diffuser和MindEye获得基于fMRI的最好的平均表面分数. 它的fMRI无错误场景的引用和脑输入控制将相机路径,大脑和预先训练的图像模型的贡献分开.

blocks.en: Limitations. DRAFT needs known camera paths and pooled recordings, was developed on these scenes with several analyses post hoc, and its brain gain was not measurable beyond low-level image features and replicated within only two of five withheld scenes ( Sections J.2 and J.1 ).
blocks.zh: 限制。 在这些场景上开发了已知的相机路径和集合录音草稿,并附有若干分析,其大脑增益除了低级图像特征外是无法衡量的,而且只复制了五个场景中的两个场景(J.2和J.1节)。

blocks.en: Outlook. Designed routes, more participants and estimated camera paths can test single-trial decoding in new scenes, and generative 3D scene models could turn the DRAFT layout into complete room reconstructions.
blocks.zh: 展望. 设计路线,更多参与者和估计的相机路径可以在新场景中测试单试解码,基因3D场景模型可以将Draft布局转化为完整的房间重建.

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This work analyzes existing fMRI recordings. The original study was approved by the institutional review board of the authors’ institution, and all participants gave written informed consent.
Analyses use coded participant identifiers and concern brain responses to rendered indoor scenes.
The method depends on participant cooperation, known camera paths and repeated recordings, and it has not been tested for unconstrained or covert decoding. Neural data and derived readouts are sensitive.

本作分析了现有的fMRI录音. 最初的研究得到提交人机构机构审查委员会的批准,所有与会者都书面表示同意。

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en:
Section 3 and Section A.1 describe the data, the cross-validation protocol and the metrics. Section 4 and Section A.2 give every model component with its hyperparameters, and Appendix B describes the statistical procedure.
Every fitted parameter and every hyperparameter chosen by inner validation is selected without the held-out scene, and each model uses one fixed seed. Fixed design settings were chosen during development, which used all ten scenes. The clearest case is the range-calibration factor a = 2 a=2 ( Section 4.3 ), fixed after earlier results on the same scenes ( Appendix G ). Nested selection by Chamfer distance picks the same value in all ten folds, and selection by F-score picks 2 or 2.5 ( Appendix G ).
Decoder predictions were frozen before scoring under a written plan ( Appendix C ), and the transfer of the layout to five of the seven decoders is a post hoc analysis ( Section C.2 ). One generator fold trains in about 15 minutes on one GPU ( Section A.2 ).
We will also release a static demo website that runs offline, with an interactive viewer of the ten atlas routes, one per scene, chosen by a fixed rule, which shows predicted depth maps and merged 3D surfaces next to the ground truth.
Upon publication, we will release the code for the method, trained models, evaluation manifests and derived readouts. Voxel-level fMRI data remain subject to the original consent and institutional data-sharing rules, and the derived readouts alone are not sufficient to retrain the cortical decoder.

blocks.en:
Each video is an 80-second first-person walkthrough of a furnished indoor scene at 30 frames per second.
The four styles of a scene (modern, Scandinavian, wabi-sabi and minimalist) share the floor plan and visit the rooms in the same order.
Their camera paths are not frame-synchronized, so pooling across styles only pairs videos whose poses agree at the same second ( Sections 4.1 and A.3 ).
Seven scenes have all four styles, and the others two or three ( Table 4 ).

每段录像是80秒的第一人称通道,每秒30帧。
一个场景的四种风格(现代,斯堪的纳维亚,瓦比萨比和最小化)共用地板图案,并按同样的顺序参观房间.
他们的相机路径不是帧同步的,所以跨样式的集合只包含姿势在同一秒一致的对视频(第4.1节和A.3节.
七幕全有四种风格,其他两三幕(表4).

For every second we cast rays from the recorded camera pose through a 384 × 512 384\times 512 pinhole grid with a 90° horizontal field of view and record the radial depth to the first surface of the 3D model, not the optical-axis depth.
Depth is stored at 96 × 128 96\times 128 and averaged in inverse depth to 48 × 64 48\times 64 .
Depth Anything V2 predicts optical-axis depth z z , converted to radial depth r = z / u z r=z/u_{z} ( 𝒖 {\bm{u}} : unit camera ray) before downsampling.
Pixels closer than 5 cm or without hits are invalid.

blocks.en:
Blood-oxygen-level-dependent (BOLD) responses are resampled to the 2 mm MNI152NLin6Asym template and z-scored within each run.
The readout uses V1 (3,004 voxels), V2 (2,020), ventral V3 (V3v, 866) and human V4 (hV4, 1,160).
These are group regions from the Juelich maximum-probability atlas at a 25% threshold, not retinotopic maps measured in each participant.
Targets are seconds 0 to 73, which leaves six seconds of video after the last target for the longest readout lag. Evaluation uses seconds 0 to 71, in nine non-overlapping eight-second routes.
Run time series are linearly interpolated at stimulus-locked one-second centers, matching the repetition time (TR) of 1 s.

运行时间序列在刺激锁定的一秒中心进行线性插值,匹配1秒的重复时间(TR).

blocks.en:
Before the stimulus windows are cut out, each run is detrended, z-scored and cleaned by regressing out 24 head-motion terms, cerebrospinal fluid and white-matter signals, five anatomical component-based noise correction (aCompCor) components and the available cosine terms.
These head-motion terms differ from the camera-motion regressors of the readout.
A run can contain several scenes, so this cleaning is not refit within each fold and can couple training and test responses.
No depth target enters it.
The results therefore describe offline decoding from run-cleaned responses, not independent preprocessing of a new scene.

这些头动词与读出时的相机动作反射器不同.
跑步可以包含多个场景,因此这种清洁不会在每叠内重置,可以对培训和测试反应进行对接.
没有深度目标进入它。
因此,结果描述了从运行清理的响应中脱机解码,而不是对新场景的独立预处理.

blocks.en:
The generator is a 3D U-Net with 5.9M parameters and 48, 96 and 144 channels at three resolutions. It downsamples space twice but never the eight views. It uses residual blocks with group normalization, and two attention blocks at the lowest resolution apply spatial and temporal self-attention (four heads).
Its input channels are the flow state 𝒛 τ {\bm{z}}_{\tau} , the coarse depth 𝑫 0 {\bm{D}}^{0} and the uncertainty map 𝑺 0 {\bm{S}}^{0} . The flow target 𝒛 1 {\bm{z}}_{1} is the residual between the true inverse depth and 𝑫 0 {\bm{D}}^{0} , divided by one root-mean-square scalar ρ \rho . The scalar ρ \rho is computed on the training scenes and frozen for test time.
The flow timestep and a 116-number vector condition the network through feature-wise linear modulation (FiLM), after a multilayer perceptron (MLP) of width 256. The vector holds the 22 posterior means and 22 posterior spreads, averaged over the eight views, and 72 motion features. They describe each of the eight views by its local position change, the sine and cosine of the heading change, pitch, eye-height change, speed and turning speed, and are standardized with fixed means and scales from 15,060 routes of ProcTHOR ( Deitke et al., 2022 ) , a set of synthetic houses. This is the only external data. No weights pretrained on the Natural Scenes Dataset (NSD) or on external depth data are used.
We train with AdamW (learning rate 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} ), gradient clipping at 1.0, an exponential moving average of weights with decay 0.999, batch size 16 and bf16 precision for 20,000 steps. One fold takes about 15 minutes and 3.7 GB of memory on one NVIDIA RTX 5090.
Training uses all 67 overlapping routes of each training video (2,144 to 2,278 routes per fold), and testing the nine non-overlapping routes of each video. We draw eight samples per recording with 48 Euler steps and average all samples of a video in inverse depth. The reciprocal of this average, in meters, is 𝑫 ˇ t \check{{\bm{D}}}_{t} .

blocks.en:
The ten held-out scenes are the units of the bootstrap and sign-flip tests. Response windows of 2 to 6 s make neighboring views share BOLD samples, so per-view scores are not independent.
For a mean metric such as layout r r or pixel MAE, we take the difference between two methods on every route and average it within each scene.
We then resample the ten scene differences with replacement 20,000 times and report the ten-scene mean with the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles (paired scene bootstrap).
For rate metrics such as row order, each scene pools its eligible cell pairs before differencing.
Main-table layout and pixel-MAE point estimates instead pool all routes or pairs (route-pooled values), so they can differ slightly from ten-scene means.
All intervals are descriptive 95% intervals without correction for multiple comparisons. All ten scenes were used during development, and each model was trained with one seed. Pose noise was tested at registration ( Section F.3 ) and, post hoc, in the camera-path inputs ( Appendix I ). Single recordings with the corrected generator were tested only post hoc ( Appendix I ). Filmed real scenes, single-participant models and unobserved surfaces were not tested.
Each analysis uses one fixed bootstrap seed, released with the code.
Intervals of the historical models, trained before the loss correction ( Appendix H ), were route-weighted and are not combined with the corrected contrasts.

blocks.en: All decoders share the folds, routes, targets and metrics of DRAFT, and every trainable part is fit on the nine training scenes of each fold.

blocks.en:
Decoders read participant-averaged responses, averaged over 2 to 6 seconds after each view, from seven regions of interest (ROIs). These are V1, V2, V3v and hV4 in early visual cortex and the scene-selective occipital place area (OPA), parahippocampal place area (PPA) and retrosplenial complex (RSC). A method that prescribes early visual areas uses V1 to hV4, and one that prescribes higher visual areas uses hV4, PPA, OPA and RSC.
Each view’s video frame is resized to the input size of each model without cropping.
Reconstructed images are converted to metric depth with Depth Anything V2 (DA V2) Metric Indoor Large ( Yang et al., 2024b ) . It overestimates depth on our rendered scenes by about a factor of 1.75, so we correct its scale with a log-affine map fitted on the frames of the training scenes (DA V2 scale calibration).
Predictions were frozen before scoring under a written plan.
The decoders read responses averaged over 418 recordings, and DRAFT over 416. The two extra recordings (one participant, minimalist style of scenes 9 and 10) have no second style to pool with. The trajectory layout uses no fMRI, and decoders with the DRAFT layout combine the two sets of responses.

每个视图的视频框被调整为每个模型的输入大小,而不裁剪.
重构的图像与深度Anything V2(DA V2) Metric Indoor Large(Yang等人,2024年b)转换为度量深度. 它高估了我们制作的场景的深度,大约是1.75倍,所以我们用一个安装在训练场景框架上的对数-亚芬地图(DA V2比例校准)来校正其规模.
在根据书面计划评分前,预测被冻结。
解码员平均阅读418份录音,416份草稿。 两个额外的录音(一个参与者,场景9和10的最小主义风格)没有第二种风格可以与之汇合. 轨迹布局使用没有fMRI,与Draft布局的解码器结合了两组响应.

blocks.en:
Linear depth decoding maps fMRI to the first 64 principal components of log depth with ridge regression ( Hoerl & Kennard, 1970 ) , a standard linear approach to fMRI decoding ( Naselaris et al., 2011 ) . CLIP retrieval maps fMRI to the image embedding of CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training) ViT-L/14 ( Radford et al., 2021 ) with ridge regression, a simple analogue of the contrastive retrieval branch of MindEye ( Scotti et al., 2023 ) , and averages the depth maps of the ten nearest training frames. Image decoding follows Takagi & Nishimoto (2023a) . Early visual cortex predicts the Stable Diffusion latent, and higher visual cortex predicts the text embedding of a caption. Takagi & Nishimoto (2023a) averaged the five human-written captions of each image in the COCO dataset. Video frames have no captions, so we instead caption each frame with BLIP, an image captioning model ( Li et al., 2022 ) . Image-to-image diffusion then generates the image (strength 0.8, 50 denoising diffusion implicit model steps, guidance 5.0). Depth decoding ( Takagi & Nishimoto, 2023b ) predicts hidden states of the dense prediction transformer DPT-large ( Ranftl et al., 2021 ) , whose head outputs relative depth calibrated on the training scenes. Brain-Diffuser ( Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023 ) predicts latents of a very deep variational autoencoder (VDVAE) ( Child, 2021 ) and CLIP image and text embeddings that guide Versatile Diffusion ( Xu et al., 2023 ) (strength 0.75, mixing 0.4). It keeps its released step that re-scales its predictions to their mean and spread over the held-out videos. This step uses no labels, but it uses all held-out predictions at once (it is transductive). MindEye ( Scotti et al., 2023 ) trains an MLP (width 1024, 64 epochs per fold) to predict CLIP ViT-L/14 hidden states, and a low-level branch starts Versatile Diffusion image variation (strength 0.85). Our version omits the ConvNeXt contrastive term and uses the Versatile Diffusion autoencoder for low-level targets.
We did not reproduce Gaziv & Irani (2021) , full DREAM ( Xia et al., 2024 ) or MinD-Video. Our adaptations decode each view alone, so they cannot show that DRAFT beats temporal fMRI-to-video decoders.
blocks.zh:
线性深度解码图 fMRI 以山脊回归为逻辑深度的前64个主要组成部分(Hoerl & Kennard,1970年),FMRI解码的标准线性方法(Naselaris等人,2011年). CLIP检索图 fMRI到CLIP(Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training)的图像嵌入图 VIT-L/14(拉德福德等人,2021年)与脊回归,MindEye的对比检索分支(Scotti等人,2023年)的简单模拟,平均10个最近训练框的深度图. 图像解码跟随高木和西本(2023a). 早期的视觉皮层预测稳定扩散潜伏,更高的视觉皮层预测一个标题的文本嵌入. Takagi & Nishimoto(2023a)在COCO数据集中平均为每个图像的五个人写字幕. 视频框没有字幕,所以我们用BLIP,一个图像字幕模型(Li等人,2022年)来给每个帧做字幕. 然后图像到图像的传播生成图像(强度0.8,50去诺的传播隐含模型步骤,指导5.0). 深度解码(Takagi & Nishimoto,2023b)预测密集预测变压器DPT-大(Ranftl等人,2021年)的隐藏状态,其头部输出相对深度校准在训练场景上. Brain-Diffuser(Ozcelik & VanRullen, 2023年)预测了非常深的变异自编码器(VDVAE)(Child, 2021年)和引导Versatile扩散的CLIP图像和文本嵌入(Xu等人, 2023年)(strent 0.75,混合0.4)。 它保持其发布的步骤,将预测重新调整到其平均值,并传播到被搁置的视频中. 这个步骤没有使用标签,但它同时使用所有被搁置的预测(它是转录的). MindEye(Scotti等人,2023年)列车MLP(width 1024,每叠64个历程),以预测CLIP ViT-L/14隐藏状态,一个低级分支启动Versatile扩散图像变异(strength 0.85). 我们的版本省略了ConvNEXt对比词,并对低级目标使用Versatile Difusion自动编码器.
我们没有转载Gaziv & Irani (2021), full DREAM (Xia et al., 2024) 或 MinD-Video. 我们的改编单独解码每个视图,所以它们不能显示Draft比Time fMRI对视频解码器.

blocks.en: On the penalty grids of Takagi & Nishimoto (2023a) and of depth decoding, every fold chose the largest penalty, so the best one could lie outside these grids. With these penalties image decoding also produced textureless color fields. We therefore report the stronger “wider ridge” variants, fit on a wider grid. For linear depth, a wider grid selected the same penalty.
blocks.zh: 在高木&西本(2023a)和深度解码的罚网格上,每个折叠都选择了最大的罚网格,所以最好的可以置身于这些网格之外. 通过这些惩罚性图像解码也产生了无纹理色彩场. 因此,我们报告较强的“更宽的山脊”变体,适合更广泛的网格。 对于线性深度,一个更宽的网格选择了相同的惩罚.

blocks.en:
We test whether CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings pick the viewed frame over another frame of the same held-out scene. This two-way identification is 0.500 and 0.525 for the official and wider-ridge versions of Takagi & Nishimoto (2023a) , 0.627 for Brain-Diffuser and 0.624 for MindEye (chance 0.5).
The grayscale structural similarity (SSIM) of the wider-ridge decoded images to the viewed frame is 0.651, against 0.649 for another frame of the same scene.
So the images are indoor scenes that match their specific view weakly at best ( Appendix K ).
blocks.zh:
我们测试CLIP VIT-L/14嵌入是否从同一悬停场景的另一帧中选择被查看的帧. 这种双向识别是高木&西本(2023a)的官方版本和较宽的山脊版本的0.500和0.525,Brain-Diffuser为0.627,MindEye为0.624(chance 0.5).
较宽的山脊解码图像的灰色比例结构相似度(SSIM)为0.651,而同一场景的另一帧为0.649.
因此,图像是室内场景,最多只能与它们的具体视野(附录K)相对应.

blocks.en: C.1 DREAM depth branch
blocks.zh: C.1 梦想深度分支

blocks.en:
We adapt the released depth-regression branch of DREAM ( Xia et al., 2024 ) , which uses a VDVAE pretrained on ImageNet.
In each fold, ridge regression (penalty fixed at 50,000) maps the fMRI of the training scenes to VDVAE latents of depth images, coded as gray level log ⁡ ( d / 0.05 ) / log ⁡ ( 600 ) \log(d/0.05)/\log(600) at 64 × 64 64\times 64 . Eight decoded samples are averaged per view.
Two differences remain. The DREAM depth branch has no camera input, and it reads the decoders’ responses, which average two more recordings.
The primary contrast, fixed in advance, is the DREAM depth branch minus the generator alone in Chamfer distance at a = 1 a=1 . It is + 0.134 +0.134 m [0.097, 0.175], and all ten scenes favor the generator. F-score is also lower in all ten scenes.
The DREAM depth branch has the better layout r r ( + 0.128 +0.128 [0.087, 0.158], nine scenes) and is better on most other depth-map layout measures ( Appendix K ). The differences in input and cohort prevent attributing the gap to the architecture.
blocks.zh:
我们改造了DREAM(Xia et al., 2024)的释放的深度递归分支,该分支使用在ImageNet上预训的VDVAE.
每个折叠中,山脊回归(固定在5万平方英尺处)将训练场景的fMRI映射到深度图像的VDVAE潜伏,编码为灰度对数QQ(d/0.05)/对数X(600)\log(d/0.05)/\log(600)在64x6464\时,每个视图平均有8个解码样本.
犹有两异. DREAM深度分支没有摄像头输入,它读取解码器的回复,平均还有两张录音.
预先固定的主反差是DREAM深度分支乘以1 a=1的Chamfer距离单发电机. 它是+0.134+0.134 m [0.097,0.175],所有十个场景都倾向于生成器. F分数在所有十幕中也较低.
DREAM深度分支有较好的r(+0.128+0.128 [0.087,0.158],9场景)布局,在大多数其他深度图布局度量法(附录K)上较好. 由于投入和组别的差异,无法将差距归因于架构。

blocks.en: The range ratio measures how much of the true depth spread a prediction keeps ( Section 5.4 ). It divides the standard deviation of the predicted 3 × 4 3{\times}4 cell log depths by that of the true ones, so its ideal value is 1. Before range calibration, the route-pooled range ratios of our ridge layouts are 0.46 for the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target, 0.50 for the trajectory head from motion, 0.54 for the trajectory head with free space and 0.49 for DRAFT. The ratio is 0.78 for the generator, and DA V2 gives Brain-Diffuser and MindEye 0.84. Range calibration raises the ratio of DRAFT to 0.97. Appendix K summarizes ten-scene means instead.
blocks.zh: 测距比率衡量一个预测所保持的真实深度(第5.4节)。 它将预测的3×4 3×times}4的细胞日志深度的标准偏差除以真实的,所以它的理想值是1. 测距校准前,我们山脊布局的路由集合射程比值为0.46,读取目标为3×3 3×Times}3,轨迹头从运动开始为0.50,轨迹头为0.54,空闲空间为0.49. 发电机的比例为0.78,DA V2给出了Brain-Diffuser和MindEye 0.84. 范围校准将草案的比例提高到0.97。 附录K总结了十景的意思。

blocks.en: C.2 Post hoc layout transfer to all seven decoders
blocks.zh: C.2 联合国 后临时布局切换到所有七个解码器

blocks.en: After the two planned combinations ( Appendix G ) were scored, we asked whether the layout guides every decoder and applied the same low-frequency replacement ( Equation 4 ) to the frozen depth of all seven decoders, with the trajectory layout or the DRAFT layout, and scored each version at a = 1 a=1 and a = 2 a=2 (every score and paired difference omitted; Appendix K ). The transfer’s Brain-Diffuser and linear-depth rows reproduce the planned combinations exactly, and its a = 2 a=2 versions form the “+ path” and “+ DRAFT” columns of Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 在两个计划中的组合(附录G)获得分数后,我们询问布局是否引导每个解码器,并对所有七个解码器的冻结深度应用相同的低频替换(方程式4),并带有轨迹布局或草稿布局,每个版本的分数为=1 a=1和1 =2 a=2(每个分数和对数差省略;附录K). 该转移的Brain-Diffuser和线性深入的行完全复制了计划中的组合,其a=2 a=2版本构成表2的“+路径”和“+草案”栏。

blocks.en: With the DRAFT layout, every decoder reaches a layout r r of 0.487 to 0.493, whatever its own value (0.171 to 0.429). Over the trajectory layout, the DRAFT layout raises layout r r by 0.036 to 0.041 and lowers pixel MAE by 0.077 to 0.078 m, in all ten scenes for each decoder (sign-flip p = 0.002 p=0.002 each). Row order and left/right gain less (0.007 to 0.015), and no sign-flip p p is below 0.05.

blocks.en:
The surfaces are mixed. At a = 1 a=1 , the replacement lowers the F-score of the three decoders whose surfaces are best alone (Brain-Diffuser, MindEye and CLIP retrieval) in at least eight of ten scenes each, and raises their Chamfer distance in at least seven. It helps the two with the weakest surfaces, depth decoding and the DREAM depth branch. At a = 2 a=2 , every decoder except linear depth has a higher F-score with the DRAFT layout than alone. But the factor was fixed for the layout rows, and it hurts the unmodified decoders. Unmodified Brain-Diffuser, for example, has an F-score of 0.492 at a = 1 a=1 and 0.424 at a = 2 a=2 . So these contrasts do not show that the layout beats each decoder at its own best factor. For Brain-Diffuser, that comparison is within noise ( Appendix G ).
The brain part of the DRAFT layout adds little to the surfaces. Over the trajectory layout, the F-score changes by + 0.017 +0.017 to + 0.020 +0.020 at a = 1 a=1 , with every interval including zero, and by + 0.014 +0.014 to + 0.023 +0.023 at a = 2 a=2 . The Chamfer distance at a = 2 a=2 falls by 0.018 to 0.030 m in seven to nine scenes, but the sign-flip p p is above 0.05 for linear depth, depth decoding and the DREAM depth branch. The exact sign-flip test is the conservative reading.

blocks.en: Panel (a) of Table 5 compares DRAFT itself with each decoder under the three conditions of Table 2 . Given the same camera path, that is, with the trajectory layout, every decoder has a lower layout r r than DRAFT, in eight to ten scenes (sign-flip p ≤ 0.010 p\leq 0.010 ). The intervals exclude zero in 17 of 21 cases (sign-flip p ≤ 0.037 p\leq 0.037 ). The four exceptions are the F-score and Chamfer distance of Brain-Diffuser and MindEye, whose gains are small ( p ≥ 0.35 p\geq 0.35 ). Table 1 gives it for DRAFT. It is 0.501 m for depth from the video frames and 1.188 m for the fixed template.

blocks.en: Appendix D Brain-input controls and cortical regions
blocks.zh: 附录D 大脑输入控制和皮质区域

blocks.en: These controls ask what the brain adds to camera motion, which cortical input carries layout information and whether the pipeline depends on it. None tests biological causation.
blocks.zh: 这些控制器询问大脑在相机运动中增加了什么,哪个皮质输入包含布局信息以及管道是否依赖于它. 没有检验生物因果关系。

blocks.en: D.1 Camera motion, free space and EVC
blocks.zh: D.1 相机运动、自由空间和EVC

blocks.en:
One test of what EVC adds to camera motion keeps the motion input fixed. We fit the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target, on the same folds, to the 12 camera-motion regressors alone (motion alone). It reaches a layout r r of 0.338 (route-pooled), and adding EVC raises it by 0.098 [0.053, 0.151], in nine scenes ( p = 0.004 p=0.004 ).
A second comparison starts from the trajectory head on the 72 motion features alone (layout r r 0.390, Table 1 ). Two alternatives beat it by the same amount, each in eight scenes: the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target from EVC and the 12 regressors, by 0.050 [0.015, 0.092] ( p = 0.025 p=0.025 ), and the trajectory head with free space added to the motion features, by 0.050 [0.022, 0.076] ( p = 0.012 p=0.012 ). The readout also lowers pixel MAE by 0.117 m [0.061, 0.172] in eight scenes ( p = 0.010 p=0.010 ). The two read different motion inputs, so this comparison alone does not isolate EVC.
blocks.zh:
一次测试EVC在相机运动中添加了什么,保持运动输入固定. 我们把读数装上一个3×3 3×Times}3 个目标,在同一折叠上,单靠12个相机运动退步器(仅靠运动). 它达到0.338的r布局(route-pooled),加上EVC使其提升0.098 [0.053,0.151],在9场景(p=0.004 p=0.004).
第二项比较是从72个运动特征的轨迹头开始的(layout r 0.390,表1)。 两种选择以相同数量将其击败,各在8场景中:从EVC和12个退步器中以3×3 3 3×times}3目标读出,以0.050 [0.015,0.092] (p=0.025 p=0.025),运动特性中加入自由空间的轨迹头,以0.050 [0.022,0.076] (p=0.012 p=0.012). 读出还将像素MAE在8场景中低0.117 m [0.061,0.172] (p=0.010 p=0.010). 两者读取不同的运动输入,因此仅此比较并不能孤立EVC.

blocks.en: D.2 Matched-budget comparison of cortical regions
blocks.zh: D.2 皮层区域的预算对比

blocks.en: To test the choice of EVC ( Section 4.1 ), we compare EVC (V1, V2, V3v and hV4), scene-selective regions (OPA, PPA and RSC) and their union under one readout fixed before scoring: 1,000 most reliable voxels, 16 principal components, ridge penalty γ = 0.1 \gamma=0.1 and a 2 to 5 s lag window. Voxel ranking, principal components and standardization use only the nine training scenes of each fold. Every readout includes the 12 camera-motion regressors, and a ridge on these alone is the reference. The comparison tests the readout alone, without a noise ceiling.
blocks.zh: 为了测试EVC的选择(第4.1节),我们比较EVC(V1,V2,V3v和hV4),场景选择区域(OPA,PPA和RSC)及其结合,在评分前固定的一次读出下:1000个最可靠的Voxels,16个主要组件,脊刑γ = 0.1\gamma=0.1,以及一个2到5秒的滞后窗口. Voxel排名,主要组件和标准化只使用每个折叠的9个训练场景. 每一个读出都包括12个相机运动回转器,单这些上的一个脊就是参考. 比较测试单读出,没有噪音天花板.

blocks.en: EVC predicts the code best ( Table 6 ). In cosine similarity, it beats the scene-selective regions by 0.160, in nine scenes, and these still beat motion alone by 0.059, also in nine scenes (intervals in Tables 3 and 6 ). Adding the scene-selective regions to EVC changes little: the union minus EVC is − 0.0003 -0.0003 [ − 0.0030 -0.0030 , 0.0018] in cosine similarity, and the union’s mean squared error is lower by only 0.0010 [0.0002, 0.0021]. This is expected, because the union’s reliability ranking keeps 979 to 992 EVC voxels and only 8 to 21 scene-selective voxels per fold (PPA 5 to 18, OPA 0 to 3, RSC 0 to 2). The union therefore does not test a separate budget for the scene-selective regions, and no comparison shows that a region is necessary. For every input, wall distances are the best predicted of the four groups of entries, a property of these targets and this readout.
blocks.zh: EVC预测代码最好(表6 ). 在余弦相似性中,它以0.160击败场景选择区域,在9场景中,这些仍然单独击败运动0.059,同样在9场景中(表3和表6中的间隔). 将场景选择区域加入EVC,变化不大:工会减EVC是−0.0003 - 0.0003 [−0.0030 - 0.0030,0.0018],工会的平均平方差只有0.0010 [0.0002,0.0021]. 预计这样,因为工会的可靠性排名保持了979至992个EVC voxels,每叠只有8至21个场景选择性 voxels(PPA 5至18,OPA 0至3,RSC 0至2). 因此,工会不测试选址地区单独的预算,没有比较表明一个地区是必要的。 对于每个输入,墙距是四组条目的最佳预测,这些目标的一个属性和这个读出.

blocks.en: The responses used here average 25 and 37 recordings in scenes 9 and 10, against 24 and 36 for DRAFT, so this is not a full-pipeline ablation with one cohort. Camera-motion regressors do not control image motion from texture, occlusion and parallax, so it shows predictive information, not a 3D representation independent of image features ( Shafer-Skelton et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 这里使用的答复平均为第9和第10场的25和37场录音,而草案为24和36场录音,因此这不是一个组的全管断音。 相机-运动递减器不能控制来自纹理,闭塞和抛物的图像运动,因此它显示的是预测性信息,而不是独立于图像特征的3D表示(Shafer-Skelton等人,2026年).

blocks.en: A gain carried by the BOLD response should peak a few seconds after the stimulus and vanish when the BOLD series is shifted. We refit the readout with single-second lags from 0 to 6 s and, for the 2 to 5 s window, after circular shifts of the BOLD series by 20 offsets from 10 to 70 s ( Figure 5 ). The gain over motion alone is largest at 3 and 4 s, in all ten scenes (0.205 [0.143, 0.266] and 0.204 [0.135, 0.271]). It is smallest at 0 s, at 0.054 [0.010, 0.091], in eight scenes. Some gain at 0 s is expected, because the layout code changes slowly and the hemodynamic response is spread in time. The unshifted gain (0.219) exceeds all 20 shifted gains (largest 0.077), a permutation p p of 1/21. The pooling partner does not enter this readout.
blocks.zh: BOLD反应带来的收益应在刺激后几秒钟达到顶峰,并在BOLD系列转移时消失. 我们以1秒的滞后时间从0秒回转至6秒,对于2秒回转至5秒的窗口,BOLD系列的圆形转变后,由10秒回转至70秒回转20倍(图5)。 仅运动的增益最大,为3和4s,在所有十个场景中(0.205 [0.143,0.266]和0.204 [0.135,0.271]). 它在0s,0.054[0.010,0.091]时最小,在8场景中. 预期在0s时会有一定增益,因为布局代码变化缓慢,血动力反应在时间上传播. 未转移收益(0.219)超过所有20个已转移收益(最大0.077),长期p 1/21。 集合伙伴不输入此读出 。

blocks.en: D.3 Replacing the EVC features
blocks.zh: D.3 联合国 替换 EVC 特性

blocks.en: To test whether the fitted pipeline uses the EVC features it receives at test time, for each recording and its pooling partner we set the scores of the EVC principal components to their training-scene center and keep the fitted readout. Camera-motion regressors, model weights, pooling partners, posterior spreads, trajectory layouts and reliability masks stay fixed. We recompute the posterior means and everything that depends on them: coarse depth, uncertainty maps and DRAFT layouts. With intact (unaltered) features, the layout r r of DRAFT is higher by 0.0373 and its F-score at a = 2 a=2 by 0.0363, in all ten scenes. Its pixel MAE falls by 0.0418 m and its Chamfer distance by 0.0251 m, both in nine scenes (intervals in Table 7 ). In scene 1, pixel MAE and Chamfer distance at a = 2 a=2 are worse, although layout r r and F-score improve. For the generator alone, the Chamfer change at a = 2 a=2 is +0.0028 m [ − 0.0037 -0.0037 , 0.0091], within noise. This control is not a shuffle of the raw BOLD signal. The posterior spreads keep information from the intact fit, and centered features can combine unusually with the unchanged camera-motion regressors.
blocks.zh: 为了测试安装的管道是否使用测试时收到的EVC特性,对于每次录制及其集合伙伴,我们把EVC主要部件的分数设定在他们的训练场中心,并保持安装的读取. 相机运动反冲器,模型重量,集合伙伴,后扩散,轨迹布局和可靠性罩保持不变. 我们重新计算后期手段和一切依赖于它们:粗细的深度,不确定的地图和草稿布局. 具有完好无损(未改变)的特征,Draft r的布局比0.0373高,其F-scount at a = 2 a = 2 by 0.0363,在所有十景中. 它的像素MAE下降0.0418米,它的Chamfer距离下降0.0251米,均在9场景中(表7中的间隔). 在场景1中,一个=2 a=2的像素MAE和Chamfer距离更差,不过布局r和F分数都有改善. 光是发电机,Chamfer在a = 2 a = 2 时的变化为+ 0.0028 m [− 0.0037 - 0.0037, 0.0091],在噪声中. 此控制不是原始 BOLD 信号的洗涤 。 后传使信息远离完好无缺的适合器,中心特征可以不寻常地与不变的相机运动递归器结合.

blocks.en: D.4 Circular shift of the primary BOLD signal
blocks.zh: D.4 主要BOLD信号的循环转换

blocks.en: Feature replacement keeps the fitted readout. To test whether the full pipeline also depends on the timing of the BOLD signal, we circularly shift the primary BOLD signal (that of the evaluated recording) by 37 of 80 positions before lag averaging and fit a separate principal component analysis and ridge readout on the shifted data. The camera-motion regressors are not shifted. Voxel rankings, posterior spreads and masks from the intact data are kept, and we regenerate every dependent prediction on 324 matched eight-view routes. The primary contrast, fixed in advance, is the F-score of DRAFT at a = 2 a=2 . The intact signal raises it from 0.4403 to 0.4840 (by 0.0436) in all ten scenes (interval in Table 3 ). Chamfer distance favors the intact signal on average but not in every scene. At a = 2 a=2 , intact BOLD gives the generator a worse Chamfer distance in scenes 2 and 9, and DRAFT a worse one in scene 1. At a = 1 a=1 , both improve in all scenes. Layout r r does not depend on a a , so its two contrasts are one result. Because the readout is refitted and information from the intact data remains, this is not a complete null control. Table 7 summarizes both controls.
blocks.zh: 特性替换保留了装配的读取功能. 为了测试整个管道是否还取决于BOLD信号的时间安排,我们循环将BOLD主要信号(经评价的记录)在80个位置中的37个位置转移,然后才进行平均滞后,并在所转移的数据上安装单独的主元件分析和读脊。 相机运动回转器不转动. Voxel 排名 后传 和口罩 从完整数据保存, 我们再生每个依赖 预测324 匹配的八景路线。 预先确定的主要对比是F分数A=2 a=2。 完整信号将它从0.4403提升到0.4840(比0.0436),在所有十个场景中(表3中的间歇). Chamfer距离平均偏好完好无损的信号,但并不在每个场景中. 1=2 a=2 完好无缺的BOLD使发电机在第二幕和第九场出现更差的Chamfer距离,在现场出现一个更差的草稿 一、导 言 A=1 a=1,两者在所有场景中都有改善. 布局 r 不依赖于 a ,所以它的两个对比是一结果. 由于读取内容被重新整理,并且来自完整数据的信息仍然存在,这并非完全无效的控制. 表7概述了这两种控制措施。

blocks.en: D.5 Historical controls: single recordings and matched cohorts
blocks.zh: D.5 历史控制:单一录音和配对组

blocks.en: Two earlier controls agree with the corrected ones: the intact signal still helps when fewer recordings are averaged at inference. Both used the historical generator (before the loss correction, Appendix H ), no pooling across styles and the same 37-position shift. With one recording per reconstruction (readout still trained on averaged data), intact BOLD raises F-score by 0.0123 [0.0062, 0.0187] and lowers Chamfer distance by 0.0157 m [0.0076, 0.0236]. With matched cohorts (the three participants present in all ten scenes, and six participants matched within each of three acquisition blocks, with equal block weights as planned), it raises F-score by 0.0115 [0.0057, 0.0179] and lowers Chamfer distance by 0.0153 m [0.0077, 0.0226]. Neither control measures data efficiency, because the cohorts change the evaluated recordings, not the training budgets. Appendix I analyzes single recordings with the corrected generator (post hoc). Across scenes, the number of recordings ( Table 4 ) is not clearly related to the feature-replacement effect on DRAFT (Spearman correlation 0.14 for layout r r and − 0.31 -0.31 for the F-score at a = 2 a=2 , ten scenes, descriptive only).
blocks.zh: 先前的两种控制方式与修正的一致:如果根据推论平均减少录音,完整信号仍然有用。 两者都使用了历史生成器(在损失更正之前,附录H),没有跨样式的集合和相同的37位转向. 通过每次重建一次记录(读出后仍接受平均数据训练),完整的BOLD将F分数提高0.0123 [0.0062,0.0187],并将Chamfer距离降低0.0157 m [0.0076,0.0236]. 配对组(所有10个场景的3名参与者和3个购置区块内各有6名参与者配对,按计划分数相等),将F得分提高0.0115 [0.0057,0.0179],将Chamfer距离降低0.0153米 [0.0077,0.0226]. 无论是控制措施,都无法衡量数据的效率,因为各组人员改变了评估的录音,而不是培训预算。 附 录 我用修正的生成器(后临时)分析单声带。 在整个场景中,录音次数(表4)与Draft上的特征替换效果(Pearman relations 0.14 for r and − 0.31-0.31 for the F-score at a = 2 a = 2,十个场景,仅说明性)没有明显关联.

blocks.en: This section tests three explanations of the surface scores: depth range ( Section F.1 ), agreement across views ( Section F.2 ) and pose drift ( Section F.3 ).
blocks.zh: 本节对水面分数的三项解释进行了测试:深度范围(F.1节)、意见一致(F.2节)和漂移(F.3节)。

blocks.en: F.1 Depth scale
blocks.zh: F.1 深度表

blocks.en: To test whether the surface gap between methods is only a matter of depth range, we align each predicted view to its ground truth in log depth before lifting. Median alignment matches the medians ( Zhou et al., 2017 ) . The log-affine alignment also fits a slope, so it undoes range calibration as well ( Ranftl et al., 2022 , compare) . A least-squares slope shrinks noisy predictions toward the mean. This fit therefore partly measures per-view correlation again, and even the fixed template reaches F-score 0.575 under it. Both alignments use test depth and are post hoc. We also report three unaligned pixel metrics: the scale-invariant log error (SI-log, × 100 \times 100 ) ( Eigen et al., 2014 ) , the mean absolute relative error (AbsRel), and the share of pixels within a factor of 1.25 of the true depth ( δ < 1.25 \delta{<}1.25 ).

blocks.en: At a = 1 a=1 , DRAFT has a smaller change than the generator and Brain-Diffuser in all ten scenes, by 0.213 m [0.190, 0.236] and 0.543 m [0.525, 0.562]. blocks.en: F.3 Pose drift during registration
blocks.zh: F.3 联合国 登记时的松散

blocks.en: Camera poses of a new recording may be noisy, so we test how pose drift changes the surfaces, at the registration step only. The predicted depth is fixed and uncalibrated ( a = 1 a=1 ). Only the poses that lift predicted points and merge them on the 5 cm voxel grid drift, and ground truth keeps the clean poses. The drift is a horizontal translation (5, 10 or 20 cm), a yaw (1, 2 or 5 degrees) or both (10 cm with 2 degrees). It grows linearly from zero at the first view to its final value at the eighth, with five fixed seeds per route shared across levels and methods. Each method is compared with its own surface under clean poses.
blocks.zh: 新录制的相机姿势可能很吵 所以我们测试 姿势漂移如何改变表面 仅在登记阶段 预计深度为固定且未校准(a=1 a=1). 只有抬起预言点的姿势,在5厘米的阴道网格漂移上将其合并,地面真能保持干净的姿势. 漂移是一种水平翻译(5,10或20厘米),一种 ya(1,2或5度)或两者(10厘米与2度). 它从第一视野的0线性增长到第八视野的最终值,每条路由共有5个固定种子,分等级和方法. 每种方法在干净的姿势下与自己的表面比较.

blocks.en: The primary measure, fixed in advance, is the change in the F-score of DRAFT under joint drift. It is − 0.026 -0.026 percentage points [ − 0.100 -0.100 , + 0.039 +0.039 ], an interval that includes zero but does not establish equivalence. The Chamfer distance of DRAFT rises by 0.35 mm [0.02, 0.67]. The largest effect, 20 cm of translation for the generator, lowers the F-score by 0.165 percentage points and raises the Chamfer distance by 1.57 mm. Every mean change in every condition is below 0.2 percentage points in F-score, precision and recall and below 2 mm in Chamfer distance (all conditions omitted; Appendix K ). These results do not show that upstream pose estimation or the full range-calibrated pipeline ( a = 2 a=2 ) is robust, and they do not rank the two methods. Appendix I perturbs the camera-path inputs instead (post hoc).
blocks.zh: 预先确定的主要措施是修改联合漂移下的F分数草案。 它为− 0.026 - 0.026 百分点[− 0.100 - 0.100,+ 0.039 + 0.039],这个间隔包括0,但不确定等值. 简费尔(Chamfer)的Draft的距离增加了0.35毫米[0.02,0.67]. 最大效果,为发电机翻译20厘米,将F-分数降低0.165个百分点,将Chamfer距离提高1.57毫米. 每个条件的每个平均变化都低于F分数、精度和召回率的0.2个百分点,在Chamfer距离低于2毫米(所有条件均省略;附录K)。 这些结果没有表明上游的估算或全射程校准管道(a = 2 a = 2)是稳健的,它们也没有对两种方法进行排序. 附 录 我干扰了摄像头的输入(后临时)。

Its layout r r is below that of the fixed template by 0.081 [0.045, 0.114] (nine scenes). So knowing the video second does not help. blocks.en: To test whether the generator adds more than the layout, we remove its detail (the high-frequency part) from the DRAFT depth, leaving only the layout, or replace it with the detail of the fixed template (all rows omitted; Appendix K ). At a = 2 a=2 , removing the detail lowers the F-score in all ten scenes. DRAFT minus the layout without detail is + 0.042 +0.042 [0.036, 0.047] in F-score and − 0.049 -0.049 m [ − 0.057 -0.057 , − 0.040 -0.040 ] in Chamfer distance. The template detail recovers part of this loss, but DRAFT stays ahead of it by + 0.025 +0.025 [0.020, 0.030] in F-score. Layout r r changes by at most 0.006. Most of the detail’s energy is one map shared by all scenes and views (share of detail energy in that map 0.551 against 0.007 in the ground truth, a difference of + 0.544 +0.544 [0.479, 0.648], post hoc), and it barely tracks the true detail (correlation 0.026 [0.021, 0.031]). The generator therefore acts mostly as a learned prior of indoor depth detail. The vertical stripes of 𝑫 {\bm{D}} in Figure 2 belong to this shared map.

blocks.en:
The “+ path” and “+ DRAFT” columns of Table 2 combine a layout with the depth of another decoder. They apply the low-frequency replacement of Equation 4 to that depth instead of the generator’s, using the trajectory layout or the DRAFT layout. The replacement keeps the fine detail of the decoder’s depth and takes its broad structure from the layout. For the two planned decoders, the depth is the calibrated DA V2 depth of each Brain-Diffuser image or the linear depth prediction. It reuses the implementation, σ = 4 \sigma=4 pixels, layouts and range calibration of DRAFT and has no fitted parameters. For these two decoders, all combined predictions were built and frozen under a written plan before any of them was scored. The other five decoders were added post hoc ( Section C.2 ). Under the DRAFT layout at a = 2 a=2 , the detail of Brain-Diffuser raises recall over that of our generator by 0.071. It lowers precision by 0.011. Both differences hold in all ten scenes ( Table 14 b).
Without the DA V2 scale calibration, the F-scores of Brain-Diffuser and MindEye fall to 0.242 and 0.258. Their Chamfer distances rise to 0.973 and 0.847 m. Their surface scores therefore depend on the depth scale learned from the training scenes.

blocks.en: All ten folds were retrained with everything else unchanged. Predictions were frozen before scoring, and no checkpoint or factor was chosen with the new scores. The corrected generator has a lower layout r r (0.303 against 0.369) but a lower pixel MAE and better surfaces at a = 1 a=1 . The DRAFT layout stays close to its historical value (0.480 against 0.486). Table 13 lists the historical and corrected rows side by side. Range calibration raises every pixel MAE. blocks.en: H.1 Penalty ablation
blocks.zh: H.1 惩罚

blocks.en: To test whether the penalty of Equation 2 helps, we retrained the corrected generators of all ten folds without it ( λ = 0 \lambda=0 ) and compared them with λ = 0.1 \lambda=0.1 . Both versions share seed, data, architecture and evaluation. The primary measure, fixed in advance, was the Chamfer distance of the generator at a = 1 a=1 . Without the penalty it rose by 0.1032 m [0.0710, 0.1399], in all ten scenes, and its F-score changed by − 0.065 -0.065 [ − 0.087 -0.087 , − 0.045 -0.045 ]. The surfaces of DRAFT also worsened, with F-score changes of − 0.021 -0.021 ( a = 1 a=1 ) and − 0.022 -0.022 ( a = 2 a=2 ) in all ten scenes. The generator’s F-score at a = 2 a=2 changed within noise.
blocks.zh: 为了检验"方程式2"的罚则是否有帮助,我们重新训练所有十个折叠的校正发电机(QQ=0\lambda=0),并将其与QQ=0.1\lambda=0.1进行比较. 两个版本共享种子,数据,架构和评价. 预先确定的主要计量标准是发电机在1a=1时的Chamfer距离。 没有惩罚,在所有十个场景中均上升了0.1032米[0.0710,0.1399],其F得分变化为−0.065-0.065[−0.087-0.087,−0.045-0.045]. 草案的表面也恶化,F得分变化为−0.021-0.021(a=1a=1),在所有十个场景中为−0.022-0.022(a=2a=2). 发电机的F分数在2a=2时在噪音中发生变化。

blocks.en: The penalty does not help every measure. Without it, the generator’s layout r r rose by 0.1172 (from 0.301 to 0.418). Its range ratio, the predicted over the true spread of cell log depths ( Section C.1 ), fell from 0.7835 to 0.6501 at a = 1 a=1 , farther from the ideal of one, and from 1.567 to 1.300 at a = 2 a=2 , closer to one. Its pixel MAE at a = 2 a=2 , which scores the depth map before rendering, fell by 0.283 m. The penalty thus trades the generator’s layout r r for better surfaces. This result rests on one training seed (all 18 measures with intervals omitted; Appendix K ).
blocks.zh: 惩罚无助于每一项措施。 没有它,发电机的布局r r 上升了0.1172(从0.301升至0.418). 其范围比(C.1节),在细胞日志深度的真实分布上预测的比值从0.7835降至0.6501,比1a=1,离理想的比值更远,比1=2a=2的比值从1.567降至1.300,比1更接近. 它的像素MAE 以 = 2 a = 2 表示,在渲染前得分深度图,下降0.283米. 因此,惩罚用发电机的布局r来换取更好的表面。 这一结果取决于一个培训种子(所有18项措施都省略了间隔;附录K)。

blocks.en: Appendix I Post hoc robustness analyses
blocks.zh: 附录一

blocks.en: All analyses in this section are post hoc. We designed them after every result above was known and ran them on the same ten scenes. Before running any of them, we wrote down six primary tests with their decision rules and all secondary quantities. Only ridge heads and ridge readouts were refit, so the generator, the readout inputs and every number elsewhere in the paper are unchanged. Independent code recomputed each primary result, and we report every outcome, favorable or not. Statistics follow Appendix B (ten scenes as units, 95% paired scene-bootstrap intervals with 20,000 resamples, exact sign-flip tests over 1,024 sign patterns). The six primary tests are Holm-adjusted together ( Table 16 ). Steps added after a result was seen are marked. Appendix K summarizes all secondary intervals.
blocks.zh: 本节的所有分析都是临时性的。 我们设计它们 之前,所有的结果 已知 并运行在相同的十幕。 在进行其中任何一次试验之前,我们记录了六次主要试验,包括他们的决定规则和所有次要数量。 只有山脊头和山脊读数被重新校正,因此发电机,读数输入和纸张其他地方的每一个数字都没有变化. 独立代码重算每个主要结果,我们报告每个结果,无论是否有利。 统计数据沿用附录B(10场景作为单位,95%的场景-波茨夹间隔带2万个复标,精确的标志-滑动测试超过1,024个标志模式)。 6个初级测试是Holm调整的(表16)。 在看到结果后增加了步骤。 附录K总结了所有二级间隔.

blocks.en: Two results revisited here were known before we froze the plan. The first is the single-recording gain of DRAFT over the trajectory head in layout r r ( + 0.016 +0.016 , eight scenes). The second is the surface scores of DRAFT at four distance thresholds for one scene. No primary contrast had been seen, including feature replacement with single recordings.
blocks.zh: 在我们冻结计划之前,已经知道在这里重新讨论的两项结果。 第一种是Draft在r布局(+0.016+0.016,8场景)轨迹头部的单记录收益. 第二个是一幕四个距离阈值的Draft的表面分数. 没有发现任何主要对比,包括以单一录音取代特征。

blocks.en: By a protocol written before this plan, we decoded each of the 416 recordings alone, with no averaging over recordings and no pooling across styles, using the models fitted on the other nine scenes. Both versions use the generator output conditioned on that recording, so only the layout differs. Replacing the EVC features with their training mean lowers the layout r r of DRAFT by 0.012 (primary test), in eight scenes and 277 of 416 recordings. This is about a third of the pooled effect with the control layout on the same generator (0.034). Scenes 4 and 6 are slightly negative ( − 0.002 -0.002 and − 0.003 -0.003 ). A circular BOLD shift lowers layout r r by 0.016, also in eight scenes. Single-recording DRAFT is below pooled DRAFT in every scene (0.454 against 0.473). Its gain over the trajectory head is 0.016 in eight scenes, a contrast seen before the plan that scores the two with different generators. With both on one generator, the gain is 0.018 in nine scenes, and 17 of 20 participants have a positive mean gain (descriptive, as participants are nested in scenes). The readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target does not beat its motion-alone version on single recordings ( − 0.005 -0.005 , four scenes), so its advantage in Table 3 appears only with averaged recordings. The F-score of single-recording DRAFT is not lower than that of pooled DRAFT ( + 0.008 +0.008 , six scenes). These are single recordings at test time, not single-participant models, because the fitted models include the same participants’ other scenes.
blocks.zh: 根据这个计划之前写好的协议,我们单独解码了416个录音中的每一个,没有平均超过录音,也没有跨风格的集合,使用其他9个场景上安装的模型. 两个版本都使用以该录音为条件的生成器输出,因此只有布局不同. 用训练取代EVC的特性意味着将Draft r的布局降低了0.012(主测试),在8场景和416场录音中的277场. 这大约是集合效应的三分之一,其控制布局在同一发电机上(0.034). 第4和第6幕略呈负数(−0.002-0.02和−0.003-0.03)。 一个圆形BOLD转动将r的布局降低了0.016,同样在八个场景中. 单项记录草案在每一场均低于集合草案(0.454对0.473)。 它在轨迹头部的增益为8个场景中的0.016,这是在计划之前看到的对比,它用不同的发电机对两者进行评分. 使用一个生成器,在9个场景中收益为0.018,20个参与者中有17个获得正中收益(描述性,因为参与者在场景中筑巢). 使用3×3 3 3 {\times}3 目标读取在单曲录制(− 0.005-0.005,四幕)上没有击败其单曲录制的动作单曲版本,因此其在表3中的优势仅以平均录制出现. F分单曲录制草稿不低于集合草稿(+0.008+0.008,六幕). 这些是测试时的单一录音,而不是单一参与者的模型,因为安装的模型包括同样的参与者的其他场景.

blocks.en: Averaging k = 1 k=1 , 2, 3 or 6 recordings per video before fusion (up to 30 random subsets per k k ) raises layout r r from 0.456 to 0.463, 0.465 and 0.468. This slope of 0.0047 per doubling holds in all ten scenes and meets the support rule. In a check added after the result, a 37 s circular shift of each recording’s brain component, breaking its alignment with the video, left the slope unchanged (difference − 0.00003 -0.00003 , five scenes). The rise thus shows only that single recordings are noisy, and the brain signal is in the levels. The gain over feature replacement is 0.013 at k = 1 k=1 (eight scenes), 0.025 at k = 6 k=6 and 0.026 with all recordings (ten scenes each), and at k = 6 k=6 the intact component beats the shifted one by 0.036 in all ten scenes. A fit of c 0 − c 1 / k c_{0}-c_{1}/k gives an infinite-recording layout r r of 0.470. All recordings reach 0.468, and pooled DRAFT (0.473) is at this limit ( − 0.003 -0.003 ), so more recordings of the same videos would add about 0.002. The extrapolated gain over the trajectory head, 0.032, is that reported in Section 5.2 . The brain component is reproducible across participants (split-half correlation within a video 0.61). For the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target, the extrapolated limit is 0.438, equal to the trajectory head ( + 0.000 +0.000 ). These limits describe this readout and fusion head, both trained on averaged recordings, not the information available in EVC.
