blocks.en:
To test whether choosing the fixed settings on these scenes created the brain’s gain, we refitted the trajectory and fusion heads, with the same readout inputs and generator, for 300 combinations of the trajectory window K K (4, 8, 16, 37 and 73 s), the trajectory penalty (10 to 10 4 10^{4} ), the fusion penalty (1 to 10 4 10^{4} ) and the low-pass width σ \sigma (2, 4 and 8 pixels) ( Appendix K ). DRAFT beats the trajectory head in all 300 settings, by 0.010 to 0.064 (median 0.039), in at least eight scenes in 293 settings. The other seven settings have seven positive scenes, and six of them combine K = 73 K=73 s with a penalty of 10 4 10^{4} . The gain over feature replacement ranges from 0.030 to 0.052 (median 0.041), in at least nine scenes in all 300 settings. The paper’s setting does not favor the brain, because its gains (0.035 and 0.033) are at or below these medians. It does favor both heads’ absolute scores. Only 16 of the 300 settings reach its DRAFT layout r r of 0.480 (median 0.457, range 0.422 to 0.488), and the trajectory head is also near its best (0.446 against a median of 0.415). The paper’s absolute layout r r values are therefore optimistic by 0.02 to 0.03 for both heads, but their difference is not. DRAFT stays above linear depth alone (0.429, not re-tuned) in 273 of 300 settings, and all 27 failures have σ = 8 \sigma=8 .
Split into the three acquisition blocks (scenes 1 to 4, 5 to 7 and 8 to 10), both brain-input controls and the gain over the path are positive in every block. This follows from their being positive in all ten scenes, so it is not separate evidence, and the blocks share most participants. The one block contrast that could fail, DRAFT minus linear depth alone, is + 0.094 +0.094 and + 0.035 +0.035 in the first two blocks but − 0.011 -0.011 in scenes 8 to 10 (one of three scenes). Refitting both heads without the held-out block keeps the gain over the trajectory head at 0.041, in all ten scenes (readout and generator not refitted). Over 55 settings of voxel count, penalty, lag window and ensembles, the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target stays above its motion-alone version by 0.079 to 0.102 in at least nine scenes, but it is never above the trajectory head (best 0.442).
blocks.zh:
为了测试在这些场景上选择固定的设置是否创造了大脑的增益,我们用相同的读出输入和生成器重排了轨迹和聚变头,用于轨迹窗口K(4,8,16,37和73s),轨迹罚局(10至10 4 10^{4}),聚变罚局(1至10 4 10^{4})和低通道宽度\sigma(2,4和8像素)(附录K)的300个组合. 草案在所有300个设置中,在293个设置中,在至少8个场景中,将轨迹头击败0.010至0.064(中位数0.039). 其他7个设置有7个正景,其中6个结合了K=73 K=73 s,惩罚为10 4 10^{4}. 超过特性替换的增益范围为0.030至0.052(中位数0.041),在所有300个设置中,至少有9个场景. 报纸的设定不利于大脑,因为它的收益(0.035和0.033)处于或低于这些中位数。 这确实有利于两个头的绝对分数。 300个设置中只有16个达到0.480r的草案布局(中间值0.457,范围为0.422至0.488),轨迹头也接近其最佳(0.446对中值0.415). 报纸的绝对布局r值因此对两个头都持0.02到0.03的乐观态度,但两者的区别不是. 草案仅停留在线性深度以上(0.429,没有重调),在300个设置中的273个设置中,所有27个失败都有==8\sigma=8.
分为三个获取区块(场景1至4,5至7和8至10),脑输入控制以及路径收益在每一个区块都是正面的. 这是因为他们在所有十幕中都是正面的,所以它不是单独的证据,并且街区共享大多数参与者. 一个可能失败的区块对比,单是Draft减线性深度,在前两个区块中为+0.094+0.094和+0.035+0.035,但在场景8至10中为−0.011-00.11(三个场景之一). 在没有被搁置挡住的挡板的情况下将两个头部的反射将轨迹头部的增益保持在0.041,在所有10场景中(读出和发电机没有重置). 超过55个设置的 Voxel 计数,罚分,滞后窗口和综艺节目,3×3 3 3 的读出目标至少在9个场景中保持0.079至0.102在运动单独版本上方,但从未超过轨迹头(最佳0.442).

blocks.en: To test whether the brain helps most where the camera path says little, we define the path coverage of a view as the number of its 12 azimuth bins of 7.5° that the camera visits within ± 4 \pm 4 s, the window of the trajectory head. The primary test found no negative within-scene association between coverage and the per-view gain of DRAFT over feature replacement (mean Spearman correlation + 0.042 +0.042 , negative in only three scenes). Descriptively, the gain is 0.013 in views whose path covers no in-view bin (five scenes positive) and 0.043 in the others (ten scenes). The gain does not fill in where the path is blind.
blocks.zh: 为了测试大脑是否最能帮助摄像头的路径, 我们定义了一个视图的路径覆盖度, 即摄像头在 ± 4\pm 4 s 内访问的12个方位角的垃圾桶的数量, 即轨迹头的窗口。 初级测试发现,在覆盖范围与Arror的每景收益之间没有负相关联(平均Spearman相关+0.042+0.042,仅在三个场景中为负). 从描述上看,收益是0.013,其路径覆盖没有内视本(5幕正),其他(10幕)为0.043. 增益不填道无明之处.

blocks.en: At test time we added independent per-second jitter to horizontal position and heading, at five levels from 5 cm and 1° to 1 m and 20° (10 seeds each). For scale, the clean camera moves 0.33 m and turns 14° per second on average. The jitter enters the trajectory features, the readout’s camera-motion regressors and the fusion head, all trained on clean paths. Pooling partners and masks come from the clean path. The primary test, that the gain over the trajectory head grows with noise, was not supported (slope − 0.0006 -0.0006 , p = 0.81 p=0.81 ). The gain rises from 0.035 to 0.063 at 0.5 m and 10° (ten scenes at each level) and falls to 0.013 at 1 m and 20° (seven scenes). DRAFT itself is not robust. Its layout r r falls from 0.473 to 0.468, 0.460, 0.419, 0.284 and 0.083, about as fast as that of the trajectory head (0.438 to 0.070). From 0.5 m and 10° on, DRAFT is below the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target, which keeps 0.393 and 0.240 (differences − 0.109 -0.109 and − 0.157 -0.157 , no scene favoring DRAFT), and below a version of itself without the path input (0.405). The fusion head relies on the path, so a path this noisy is worse than none. The gain over feature replacement stays positive at every level (0.025 to 0.053, ten scenes each), as expected, because the brain term is the same at every level. The generator detail was not resampled. Appendix K summarizes these results and the checks with re-matched pooling partners, cumulative drift and heads refitted on noisy paths.
blocks.zh: 在测试时,我们在水平位置和方向上增加了独立的每秒焦点,在5厘米和1至1米和20度(各10个种子)的5个级别。 对于尺度,清洁相机移动0.33米,平均转14°/秒. 读取器的相机运动回转器和聚变头, 集合伙伴和面具来自干净的道路。 主要的试验是,轨迹头部的增益会随着噪音而增加,但没有得到支持(斜坡-0.0006 - 0.0006,p=0.81,p=0.81)。 增益在0.5米和10°(每层10场)时从0.035升至0.063,在1米和20°(7场)时降至0.013. 草案本身并不健全。 其r的布局从0.473降至0.468,0.460,0.419,0.284和0.083,大约与轨迹头(0.438至0.070)一样快. 从0.5米和10°起,Draft在读数以下,有一个3×3 3 3×times}3目标,它保持0.393和0.240(差数−0.109-0.109和−0.157-0.157,没有场景偏好Draft),低于没有路径输入的版本本身(0.405)。 核聚变头依靠路径,所以这种吵闹的路径比没有更糟糕. 超过特性替换的增益如预期一样,在每个级别(每个0.025至0.053,10场)保持正数,因为每个级别上的大脑术语相同. 生成器细节没有被重印 。 附录K概述了这些结果和与重新匹配的集合伙伴的核对、累积漂移和在吵闹的路径上重排头部。

blocks.en: To test whether removing the wrong-scene score of Table 12 changes the surface comparison, we reproduced every archived score within 10 − 6 10^{-6} and scored each method against its wrong-scene predictions ( Appendix G ) at 10, 25, 50 and 100 cm. The scene-specific gain, correct minus wrong-scene F-score, is 0.069 for DRAFT and 0.055 for MindEye. Their difference, + 0.014 +0.014 in six scenes, comes mostly from scenes 4 and 6, and the primary test is null. It also depends on range calibration. Without it, the gain of DRAFT is below that of MindEye ( − 0.018 -0.018 , four scenes, added after the result). The F-score of DRAFT minus that of MindEye is + 0.005 +0.005 at 10 cm (seven scenes), − 0.010 -0.010 at 25 cm (four), − 0.020 -0.020 at 50 cm (one) and − 0.011 -0.011 at 1 m (three). The primary test, that DRAFT gains on MindEye at coarser thresholds, therefore went against the hypothesis (slope − 0.0053 -0.0053 per doubling, Holm-adjusted p = 0.049 p=0.049 ), with the deficit appearing between 10 and 25 cm. Against Brain-Diffuser, the differences are + 0.006 +0.006 , − 0.008 -0.008 , − 0.014 -0.014 and − 0.007 -0.007 , and no difference in scene-specific gain exceeds noise. Within our pipeline, the layout makes the surfaces more scene-specific than the generator alone calibrated in the same way ( + 0.034 +0.034 at 25 cm, eight scenes). Of the methods scored here, Brain-Diffuser + DRAFT layout has the highest mean F-score at 25 cm, 50 cm and 1 m (0.499, 0.757 and 0.930), against 0.494, 0.752 and 0.927 for MindEye, a difference within noise at 25 cm ( Appendix G ). No wrong-scene-corrected or threshold score shows the surfaces of DRAFT beating MindEye beyond noise.
blocks.zh: 为了检验删除表12的错景分数是否改变表面比较,我们在10 - 6 10 - 6 以内复制了每个存档分数,并在10、25、50和100 厘米时对照其错景预测(附录G)对每种方法进行评分。 场景特异性收益,正确减错场面F-分数,为Draft0.069,MindEye0.055. 他们的区别,+0.014+0.014在六个场景中,大多来自场景4和6,主测试无效. 这也取决于射程校准. 如果没有它,Draft的收益就低于MindEye(−0.018-0.018,四个场景,在结果之后添加). MindEye的F-分数减法是:10厘米时+0.005+0.005(七个场景)、25厘米时−0.010-0.010(四个)、50厘米时−0.020-0.020(一个)和1米时−0.011-0.011(三个)。 因此,主要检验标准是MindEye的汇合阈值收益草案与假设相反(坡度-0.0053-0.053,Holm调整后p=0.049,p=0.049),赤字为10至25厘米。 与Brain-Diffuser相比,差异为+0.006+0.006,−0.008-0.08,−0.014-0.014和−0.007,场景特定收益的差别不超过噪音. 在我们的输油管内,布局使得表面比单发电机更符合场景特异性,用同样的方式校准(+ 0.034+0.034在25厘米,8场场景). 在此得分的方法中,Brain-Diffuser + Draft布局在25厘米,50厘米和1米(0.499,0.757和0.930)的中F分数最高,而MindEye为0.494,0.752和0.927,在25厘米(附录G)的噪声内有差异. 任何错误的场景校正或阈值分数都没有显示Draft击败MindEye超越噪音的表面.

blocks.en: They reuse the development scenes, participants and scanner runs, so they test robustness, not generalization to new scenes or people. One of the two supported hypotheses, the rise with more recordings, does not show brain signal. The single-recording result has Holm-adjusted p = 0.049 p=0.049 , close to the threshold. The design grid varies four fixed settings. The generator, pooling rule, reliability masks, 3 × 3 3{\times}3 cells, fusion architecture and 22-number layout code stay as chosen in development. The path noise is synthetic, and the limit over recordings is extrapolated.
blocks.zh: 他们重新使用开发场景,参与者和扫描仪运行,从而测试稳健性,而不是泛指新场景或新人. 支持的两种假说之一,随着更多录音的上升,没有显示大脑信号. 单录制结果有Holm调整p=0.049p=0.049,接近阈值. 设计网格有四种固定设置. 生成器,集合规则,可靠性口罩,3×3 3×times}3个细胞,聚变架构和22个数的布局代码按开发时所选择的方式保留. 路径噪声是合成的,对录音的限度是推断出来的.

blocks.en: Appendix J Post hoc analyses: withheld scenes and low-level image features
blocks.zh: 附录J 邮政特别分析:不公开的场景和低级图像特征

blocks.en: We added these two analyses last, after every result above was known. Each has a written plan with decision rules, time-stamped before any of its outcomes was computed, and each was recomputed with independent code. We report every outcome here or in Appendix K and mark every step added after a result was seen. No other number of the paper changes. Section J.2 reuses the ten development scenes with the statistics of Appendix B . Section J.1 uses scenes withheld from fitting, selecting and tuning DRAFT.
blocks.zh: 我们最后补充了这两项分析,此前,上述每一项结果都得到了了解。 每一个都有一个附有决定规则的书面计划,在计算其任何结果之前都贴上时间戳,每个计划都用独立的代码重编。 我们在此或附录K中报告每一项结果,并在看到结果后标明所增加的每一步骤。 本文其他编号不变。 J.2节用附录B的统计重新利用了十个开发场景。 J.1节使用了无法装配、选择和调整草稿的场景。

blocks.en: J.1 Scenes withheld from development
blocks.zh: J.1 联合国 禁止开发的场景

blocks.en: The first withheld scene (W1), one more of the same design (one floor plan in four styles), was recorded in the session of scenes 5 to 7 (75 recordings from 19 of the 20 participants). No component of DRAFT was fitted, selected or tuned on it, and every script that produced DRAFT refused its data. It is not unseen, though. Before DRAFT was designed, we tested an earlier readout on it once, and the recorded decision was a pass. That readout used the same six ridge configurations, trained with other scenes, but predicted a different target (13 cosine coefficients of inverse depth). The layout code, pooling, generator and both heads were designed after that outcome, and earlier generations of our pipeline had also been run on the scene. In one style the rendered camera shakes around the recorded path, so ground truth ray-cast along that path does not match what participants saw, and the plan excluded that style from the primary analysis. Five further scenes were set aside during development. One has no validated camera path and stays excluded. The other four are W2 to W5.
blocks.zh: 第一个被扣的场景(W1),又一个相同的设计(一个四色的楼层规划),被收录在场景5到7(20名参与者中的19人录制了75张录音)的会话中. 草案没有安装、选择或调整任何组成部分,每个生成草案的脚本都拒绝提供其数据。 但它不是看不见的。 在设计草案之前,我们测试过一次早先的读出,记录下来的决定就是通过. 该读取使用相同的六条脊构型,经过其他场景的训练,但预测了不同的目标(反深度的13个余弦系数). 排版码,集合,发电机和两个头都是在那个结果之后设计的,我们的管道的前几代也被运行在现场. 在一种风格中,制成的相机在录制的路径周围摇动,因此沿着该路径的地面真理线广播与参与者所看到的不匹配,计划将这种风格排除在初级分析之外. 在开发期间,还搁置了另外五个场景。 一个人没有经过验证的相机路径,因此被排除在外。 其他四个是W2到W5.

blocks.en: The plan was frozen before any prediction for W1 existed. Every component of DRAFT was retrained on all ten scenes with the paper’s settings. Inner selections kept the values chosen in most development folds (a 4 s trajectory window and penalties of 10 3 10^{3} for both heads), the generator was retrained for 20,000 steps, and all fields were frozen with hashes before the ground truth was rendered. Before any data of W1 were loaded, a rehearsal with two development scenes held out reproduced their published predictions within 10 − 9 10^{-9} . We score 27 eight-view routes in the three primary styles (56 recordings). Three primary contrasts in layout r r compare DRAFT with the trajectory head (H1), the fixed template (H2) and feature replacement with the generator resampled as in the paper (H3). With one scene, the unit of inference is the participant. A cluster bootstrap over the 19 participants (5,000 resamples) recomputes pooling, posterior, fusion and generator detail, and one-sided p p values are Holm-adjusted over the three contrasts. A contrast replicates if it is positive with adjusted p < 0.05 p<0.05 . Route and style counts are descriptive, because routes share a floor plan and, within a video, a camera path.
blocks.zh: 在W1的任何预测存在之前,这个计划就被冻结了. 草案的每个部分都按照论文的设置对所有十个场景进行了重新训练。 内部选择保留了大多数开发折叠中所选择的数值(对两个头的4 s 轨迹窗口和10 3 10^{3}的处罚),生成器被重新训练了2万步,所有字段都用散列冻结,然后才得出地面真相. 在W1的任何数据被载入之前, 我们在三种主要风格(56个录音)中得分27条八景路线. 在布局r r 比较轨迹头(H1),固定模板(H2)和像纸(H3)一样用重印的发电机替换特性的三种主对比. 一个场景,推论的单位是参与者. 在19名参与者(5 000个复标)上安装的组装靴子重新计算集合、后置、聚变和生成器细节,单侧p值则经过Holm-调整,与三种对比。 如果与调整后的p < 0.05 p < 0.05 形成正比,则形成反比。 路线和风格计数是描述性的,因为路线共享一个楼层计划,在视频中则共享一个相机路径.

blocks.en: All three primary contrasts met the replication rule (W1 row of Table 17 ). Absolute accuracy did not transfer, though. DRAFT reached a layout r r of 0.285, below every development scene and below the 95% prediction interval from the ten scenes (0.299 to 0.647). Every other layout was also lower than in any development scene, including the fixed template (0.178) and the generator alone (0.149), so the scene is harder for all methods. Feature replacement lowered layout r r in 22 of 27 routes and in every style. The gain over the trajectory head, 0.013, is about 40% of its development mean, positive in only 16 of 27 routes and negative in one style. The planned bootstrap varies only the participants, so it is narrow. Resampling routes instead, a descriptive step added after the result, gives intervals of − 0.012 -0.012 to + 0.039 +0.039 for H1, + 0.017 +0.017 to + 0.204 +0.204 for H2 and + 0.013 +0.013 to + 0.049 +0.049 for H3. The surfaces ( a = 2 a=2 , leave-one-participant-out jackknife intervals) do not reproduce the development ordering in F-score. DRAFT has a lower F-score than the generator alone calibrated in the same way (0.442 against 0.456, − 0.014 -0.014 [ − 0.027 -0.027 , − 0.001 -0.001 ]) but a lower Chamfer distance ( − 0.047 -0.047 m [ − 0.061 -0.061 , − 0.033 -0.033 ]). Its F-score is above those of the trajectory head, feature replacement, the circular shift and the fixed template ( + 0.022 +0.022 , + 0.033 +0.033 , + 0.032 +0.032 and + 0.068 +0.068 ), and its Chamfer distance is below all four. Appendix K summarizes every arm and style of W1.
blocks.zh: 所有三种主对比都符合复制规则(表17的W1行). 然而,绝对准确性并没有转移。 草案布局r为0.285,低于每个开发场景,低于从10场景(0.299至0.647)的95%的预测间隔. 所有其他布局也都低于任何开发场景,包括固定模板(0.178)和仅发电机(0.149),因此场景对所有方法来说都比较困难. 在27条路线中的22条路线和各种风格中,特色更换降低了r的布局。 轨迹正面的增益0.013约为其发展平均值的40%,在27条路线中只有16条是正数,以一种方式是负数. 计划中的靴子只有参与者不同,所以范围很窄. 作为结果后添加的描述性步骤,恢复路线的间隔为−0.012-0.012至+0.039+0.039,H1,+0.017+0.017至+0.204+0.204,H2+0.013+0.013++0.049+0.049. 表面(a = 2 a = 2,leave-one-participant-out juknife间隔)不复制F分数的开发顺序. 草案的F分数低于发电机本身的校准方法(0.442对0.456, − 0.014-0.014[ 0.027-0.027, − 0.001-001-001]),但Chamfer距离较低(− 0.047-0.047米[ 0.061-0.61, − 0.033-0033]),其F分数高于轨迹头、特征替换、循环转向和固定模板(+ 0.022+ 0.022, + 0.033+ 0.033, + 0.032+ 0.032和+ 0.068),其Chamfer距离低于全部四。 附录K总结了W1的每个臂和样式.

blocks.en: Decoded alone without pooling across styles (9 routes, 19 recordings), DRAFT was below the trajectory head in this style ( − 0.026 -0.026 [ − 0.033 -0.033 , − 0.018 -0.018 ]), a contrary result by the plan’s rule. Pooling all four styles by the rule of the paper (36 routes, 75 recordings) replicated all three primary contrasts, with + 0.013 +0.013 [0.004, 0.021] for H1 and + 0.032 +0.032 [0.023, 0.040] for H3.
blocks.zh: 单是解码,而不汇集各种风格(9条路线,19条录音),草案低于这种风格的轨迹头部(−0.026-0.026 [−0.033-0.33,−0.018-018]),这是计划规则的相反结果. 按论文规则集合所有四种风格(36条路线,75条录音)复制了所有三种主对比,H1的比分为+0.013+0.013 [0.004,0.021],H3的比分为+0.032+0.032 [0.023,0.040].

blocks.en: We analyzed W2 to W5 after the results of W1 were known, but their plan was frozen with that of W1, before any prediction for W1 existed. They have the same design and were recorded in a later session from six participants, all of whom also appear in the development scenes and five of whom also appear in W1. W2, W4 and W5 have four styles with six recordings each, and W3 has one style (the only one with ground truth) and six recordings, for 78 recordings and 117 eight-view routes. No camera shakes in these videos, so every style was scored. These scenes are more exposed than W1. They were training scenes of earlier model generations in this project, the earlier readout tested once on W1 had been trained with them, and on 2026-09-15, before W1 was tested, we had confirmed that this readout works on them. As for W1, no component of DRAFT was fitted, selected or tuned on them, and every script that produced DRAFT refused their data.
blocks.zh: 我们在得知W1的结果后对W2到W5进行了分析,但在W1的任何预测存在之前,他们的计划就和W1一样被冻结了. 其设计相同,后期有六位参与者录制,均出现在开发场景中,其中五位也出现在W1. W2,W4和W5各有4种风格,各有6个录音,W3则有1种风格(唯一一种有地面真相)和6种录音,共78种录音和117种八景路线. 这些视频中没有相机摇晃,所以每个风格都得分. 这些场景比W1更暴露. 他们是这个项目中早期模范一代的训练场景,早期在W1上测试的读取器曾经与他们一起训练过,2026-09-15年,在W1被测试之前,我们已经证实这个读取器对他们有作用. 至于W1,草案中没有安装、选择或调整其任何组成部分,每个编写草案的脚本都拒绝其数据。

blocks.en: We applied the models of W1 (generator, fusion stack, fixed template and both heads) without refitting. Before any data of W2 to W5 were loaded, a rehearsal reproduced every prediction for W1 bit for bit, including the generator samples. We then froze the predictions of every arm with hashes and a time stamp and read the first ground-truth depth only after the freeze. This ground truth was already stored with the data, so we enforced the order by blanking those rows and logging every file that the analysis processes opened. The logs cannot rule out a read by a separate process, but after the rehearsal every prediction was a deterministic, seeded function of the frozen models, so a look at the ground truth could change no choice. Scoring followed W1, with the bootstrap over six participants. The planned five-scene summary is the mean of the per-scene differences with an exact one-sided sign-flip p p over the 32 sign patterns. One deviation was written down before any data of these scenes were read. W3 has one recording per participant, so we waived a rule that requires two (it only supplies the partner recording for a control not used here) and also report a four-scene summary without W3. W3 has only one video, so pooling has no partner there. An independent reviewer reproduced every number with separate code (within 10 − 15 10^{-15} ) and found no departure from the plan.
blocks.zh: 我们应用了W1的模型(生成器,聚变堆栈,固定模板和两个头)而无需重排. 在W2到W5的任何数据被加载之前,一个排练重复了W1位位的每一个预测,包括生成器样本. 然后,我们冻结了每条手臂的预测和时间戳,并在冻结之后才读出第一个地面真相深度。 这个地面的真相已经与数据一起存储, 所以我们执行命令, 将分析过程打开的每个文件都空白。 日志不能排除通过单独过程读取,但排练后每次预测都是被冻结模型的决定性的,种子化的功能,因此看一看地面真相是无法改变的. Scoring跟随W1,靴子绑在6人以上. 计划中的五面体摘要是每面体差异的平均值,在32个标志图案上有一个精确的单面符号-flip p. 在读取这些场景的任何数据之前,一个偏差被记录下来. W3每个参与者有1个记录,所以我们放弃了一个要求2个的规则(它只提供合伙人记录一个没有在这里使用的控制),并且也报告一个没有W3的四幕摘要. W3只有一个视频,所以集合在那里没有搭档. 一名独立审查员转载了每个有单独代码的号码(10 - 15 10 - 15 ),没有发现偏离计划的情况。

blocks.en: Absolute accuracy was in the development range in the four later scenes ( Table 17 ). DRAFT reached a layout r r of 0.489, 0.476, 0.579 and 0.534 in W2 to W5, all inside the 95% prediction interval from the ten scenes (0.299 to 0.647), with W4 marginally above the top of the development range (0.578). Every layout was higher than in W1, so W1 was the hardest scene for every method. H2 replicated in all five scenes. H1 replicated only in W1 and W2 (W2: adjusted p = 0.016 p=0.016 ) and was positive but missed the rule in W3 ( p = 0.43 p=0.43 ), W4 ( p = 0.060 p=0.060 ) and W5 ( p = 0.33 p=0.33 ). H3 replicated in W1, W2 and W3 (W3: adjusted p = 0.046 p=0.046 ) and was positive but missed the rule in W4 ( p = 0.083 p=0.083 ) and W5 ( p = 0.072 p=0.072 ). The circular shift lowered layout r r in all four later scenes ( + 0.077 +0.077 , + 0.038 +0.038 , + 0.029 +0.029 and + 0.040 +0.040 ), with intervals that exclude zero only in W2 and W3. Every primary difference in every scene fell inside its development prediction interval. On single recordings without pooling, DRAFT beat the trajectory head in 10 of 24, 2 of 6, 10 of 24 and 11 of 24 recordings of W2 to W5 (W1: 31 of 56), so the gain over the path appears only when recordings are pooled across participants. Appendix K summarizes route counts and two secondary results of W5 that went against the development pattern.
blocks.zh: 在后来的四个场景中,开发范围绝对准确(表17)。 草案在W2至W5中达到0.489,0.476,0.579和0.534的r的布局,均在从十景(0.299至0.647)的95%的预测间隔内,W4略高于开发范围的顶部(0.578). 每个布局都高于W1,所以W1是每种方法最难的场景. H2在所有五个场景中复制. H1只在W1和W2(W2:调整后的p = 0.016 p = 0.016)中复制,正面但错过了W3(p = 0.43 p = 0.43),W4(p = 0.060 p = 0.060)和W5(p = 0.33 p = 0.33)中的规则. H3在W1,W2和W3(W3:调整后的p = 0.046 p = 0.046)中复制,正面但错过了W4(p = 0.083 p = 0.083)和W5(p = 0.072 p 0.072)中的规则. 后期所有四个场景(+ 0.077 + 0.077 + 0.038 + 0.038 + 0.029 + 0.029 + 0.040 + 0.040 )中循环调低调,间隔仅在W2和W3中排除零. 每一个场景的每一个主要差异都发生在其发展预测间隔内. 在没有集合的单曲录音上,Draft在W2至W5(W1: 31 of 56)的24集的10集,6集的2集,24集的10集,24集的24集的11集中击败了轨迹头部,因此在路径上的收益只有在参与者之间集合录音时才会出现. 附录K总结了与开发模式相反的W5路线计数和两个二级结果.

blocks.en: DRAFT was above the trajectory head, the fixed template and feature replacement in all five scenes, with mean differences of + 0.019 +0.019 , + 0.188 +0.188 and + 0.042 +0.042 and an exact sign-flip p p of 1 / 32 = 0.031 1/32=0.031 each ( Table 17 ). This is the smallest p p that five scenes allow, so it says only that all five differences were positive, not how large they are. W3 counts as positive for H1 with + 0.004 +0.004 and a within-scene p p of 0.43. The plan set no significance level or multiplicity rule for this summary, and Holm adjustment over the three contrasts gives 0.094 for each. Without W3, the means are + 0.023 +0.023 , + 0.182 +0.182 and + 0.043 +0.043 , with four of four scenes positive and p = 1 / 16 p=1/16 each. The circular shift gives + 0.044 +0.044 (five scenes, p = 1 / 32 p=1/32 ), and the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target minus its motion-alone version gives + 0.105 +0.105 (four scenes, p = 0.063 p=0.063 ). The sign-flip test treats the five scenes as independent, and they are not. W2 to W5 share six participants and a session, five of the six also appear in W1, and one frozen model scores all five scenes. This positive dependence makes p = 1 / 32 p=1/32 too small by an unknown amount. Within each scene the unit is the participant, and with six participants the intervals of W2 to W5 are rough. By the plan, no combination of these scenes is a test of generalization across scenes.
blocks.zh: 草案在轨迹头上方,所有五个场景的固定模板和特征替换,平均差额为+0.019+0.019,+0.188+0.188和+0.042+0.042,准确的标志-flip p=1/32=0.0311/32=0.031(各表17). 这是五个场景允许的最小p,所以它只说所有五个差异都是正面的,而不是大小. W3对H1的数值为正数,为+0.004+0.004,内色p为0.43. 该计划没有为本摘要设定意义级别或多重规则,霍尔姆对三种对比的调整分别给出0.094. 没有W3,手段为+0.023+0.023,+0.182+0.182和+0.043+0.043,四个场景中四个为正,p=1/16,p=1/16各. 循环转会给出+0.044+0.044(五个场景,p=1/32 p=1/32),读出时带有一个3×3 3 ×times}3个目标,减去其单动版本给出+0.105+0.105(四个场景,p=0.063 p=0.063). 招牌-滑板测试将五个场景视为独立,而非独立. W2到W5共有6名参与者和1场会,6场会中的5场同样出现在W1中,1场被冻结的模型得分全部为5场. 这种正依赖性使得p=1/32p=1/32因数量不明而太小. 在每个场景中,单元是参与者,有6名参与者,W2到W5的间隔很粗糙. 根据计划,这些场景的任何组合都不是对跨场景的概括的考验.

blocks.en: At the paper’s factor a = 2 a=2 , DRAFT had a higher F-score than the generator alone in W2, W4 and W5, by + 0.055 +0.055 [0.020, 0.089], + 0.047 +0.047 [0.016, 0.079] and + 0.070 +0.070 [0.056, 0.084] (jackknife intervals). It tied the generator in W3 (0.000 [ − 0.035 -0.035 , 0.035]) and was lower in W1 ( − 0.014 -0.014 [ − 0.027 -0.027 , − 0.001 -0.001 ]). Its Chamfer distance was lower than the generator’s in all five scenes, by 0.085 m to 0.128 m in W2 to W5. Against the trajectory head, the F-score was higher in W2 ( + 0.063 +0.063 [0.038, 0.088]) and W5 ( + 0.038 +0.038 [0.022, 0.054]), within noise in W4 ( + 0.024 +0.024 [ − 0.006 -0.006 , 0.055]) and lower but within noise in W3 ( − 0.013 -0.013 [ − 0.047 -0.047 , 0.020]), where the Chamfer distance of DRAFT was worse ( + 0.058 +0.058 m [0.012, 0.104]). Without range calibration ( a = 1 a=1 ) the ordering reverses: DRAFT has a lower F-score than the generator alone in all five scenes and a worse Chamfer distance (point values). The F-scores are 0.375 against 0.439 in W1, 0.424 against 0.510 in W2, 0.360 against 0.472 in W3, 0.465 against 0.529 in W4 and 0.423 against 0.484 in W5. The surface gain over the generator thus depends on the range calibration, whose factor was fixed on the development scenes.

With every prediction frozen before the ground truth was read, DRAFT beat the fixed template within all five withheld scenes and was above the trajectory head and feature replacement in all five. The brain’s contribution as defined in advance, the replication of both H1 and H3 within one scene, held in only two (W1 and W2). The gain over the trajectory head averaged + 0.019 +0.019 , about half its development mean ( + 0.035 +0.035 ), varied between routes and styles, reversed in the shaking-camera style of W1 and appeared only after pooling across participants. The absolute layout r r transferred in the four later scenes but not in W1. The surface gains over the generator alone held at a = 2 a=2 in three of the four later scenes and reversed at a = 1 a=1 in all five. These scenes were withheld, not unseen, and the earlier readout was known to work in W2 to W5. They share participants, one model and, for W1, the scanner session of scenes 5 to 7, so they are not independent replications and say nothing about new participants.
blocks.zh: 由于在读到地面真相之前,每个预测都冻结了,因此草案在所有五个被扣的场景中击败了固定的模板,在所有五个场景中都超过了轨迹头部和特征替换. 大脑预先定义的贡献,一个场景中H1和H3的复制,只维持两个场景(W1和W2). 轨迹头部的增益平均为+0.019+0.019,其开发平均值约为一半(+0.035+0.035),路线和风格各有不同,在W1的摇动-相机风格中倒置,仅在集聚到所有参与者之后才出现. 绝对布局r r在后来的四场景中转移,但在W1中没有转移. 仅发电机的表面增益在后来四个场景中的三个场景中为=2 a =2,在全部五个场景中为=1 a =1,反转. 这些场景被屏蔽,并非隐蔽的,而早期的读出已知在W2到W5工作. 他们共享参与者,一个模型,对于W1,扫描场景5至7的场面,所以他们不是独立的复制品,对新参与者一言不发.

blocks.en: J.2 Low-level image features
blocks.zh: J.2 低级图像特性

blocks.en: We test whether EVC carries layout information beyond the low-level content of the frames. For each 3 × 3 3{\times}3 cell of the frames shown at second t t , we computed mean luminance, root-mean-square contrast, log Gabor energy (3 scales, 4 orientations) and log frame-difference motion energy within ± 0.5 \pm 0.5 s. Principal component analysis on the training scenes reduced these 135 features to 16 components. We refitted the readout with a 3 × 3 3{\times}3 target of Table 3 with four input sets and all else as in the paper (six ridge configurations with fixed penalties, leave-one-scene-out folds, and the same pooling, low-frequency replacement and generator). The sets are the 12 camera-motion regressors alone (M0), motion plus the image components (M1), motion plus the 16 EVC components (M2, the paper’s readout, reproduced within 10 − 6 10^{-6} ) and motion plus both (M3). The primary test compares M3 with M1. Earlier exploratory analyses pointed to low-level mediation, so its direction was not unexpected.
blocks.zh: 我们测试EVC是否携带超出帧低级内容的布局信息. 对于第二个 t t 时显示的每个 3 × 3 3 个帧的单元格, 我们计算 平均亮度、 根- 平方对比度、 log Gabor 能量( 3 个尺度, 4 个方向) 和 log 帧- 偏移 运动能量 ± 0. 5\ pm 0. 5 s 。 对培训场景的主要部分分析将这135个功能减少到16个组件。 我们用一张3×3 3 3⁄Times}3的目标重排了表3, 上面有四套输入和所有其他文件(六根带固定罚单的山脊配置, 单层外折, 以及相同的集合, 低频替换和发电机)。 这些装置是仅12个相机运动递减器(M0),运动加图像元件(M1),运动加16个EVC元件(M2,纸张的读出,在10−6 10−6})和运动加两者(M3). 初试将M3与M1. 早期的探索性分析指出低层次调解,因此其方向并非出乎意料.

blocks.en: The primary test is null ( Table 18 ). Adding EVC to motion and image features changes layout r r by + 0.013 +0.013 [ − 0.006 -0.006 , 0.033], positive in six scenes, p = 0.25 p=0.25 . Every planned sensitivity analysis agrees: + 0.013 +0.013 and + 0.012 +0.012 with 8 or 32 image components, + 0.006 +0.006 with all 135 features, + 0.010 +0.010 with inner-validated penalties, and + 0.019 +0.019 [ − 0.003 -0.003 , 0.042] with the image features passed through a canonical hemodynamic response and the lag window of EVC. No p p is below 0.15, and the layout without generator detail gives + 0.014 +0.014 ( p = 0.21 p=0.21 ). With ten scenes, an EVC-specific gain of up to about 0.03 cannot be excluded. An exploratory measure points the other way. EVC explains unique variance in the per-view shape of the 3 × 3 3{\times}3 layout before the generator (unique cross-validated R 2 R^{2} + 0.042 +0.042 [0.016, 0.069], seven scenes, p = 0.018 p=0.018 ). M1 beats the paper’s readout (0.561 against 0.440), partly because the image features are exact for second t t and BOLD lags by seconds. With hemodynamically filtered features, the model without brain data reaches 0.474, within noise of 0.440 ( + 0.034 +0.034 [ − 0.005 -0.005 , 0.070], eight scenes, p = 0.12 p=0.12 , added after the result). Like depth estimated from the video frames ( Table 2 ), M1 uses the stimulus frames, which DRAFT never sees, so it is a stimulus-side reference, not a competing decoder. In this dataset, the layout information of EVC is not measurably separable from the low-level content of the frames. The features do not cover eye movements or other low-level features, and the limitation in Section 6 stands.

blocks.en: • Re-rendered depth metrics: definitions of the re-rendered depth metrics used only by the DREAM comparison below. • Image-decoder outputs: decoded images and depth of the image decoders on the atlas views. DRAFT has the lowest mean pixel MAE on these views, but over all routes it is worse than linear depth in scenes 1 and 8 and better in scene 4. • DREAM depth branch, with its endpoint definitions: the DREAM depth branch has a better layout r r than our generator but worse surfaces (F-score lower in all ten scenes). • All transfer scores: at a = 1 a=1 the DRAFT layout lowers the F-score of Brain-Diffuser, MindEye and CLIP retrieval. • All rows of the generator-detail ablation: at a = 1 a=1 , removing the detail lowers the F-score by 0.031, and the template detail recovers part of this. At a = 2 a=2 the detail raises pixel MAE by 0.016 m. • Uncalibrated planned combinations and contrasts: the planned combinations reach F-scores of 0.371 to 0.434, below the calibrated full DRAFT (a comparison including the calibration), and the two with the DRAFT layout have a slightly higher layout r r than DRAFT. Uncalibrated DRAFT has a lower pixel MAE than the generator and trajectory head but a lower recall than the generator, with no scene favoring DRAFT. • Precision and recall at a = 1 a=1 : uncalibrated, DRAFT has a lower recall than the generator, Brain-Diffuser and MindEye, with precision within noise. • Unaligned F-score thresholds: no unaligned F-score threshold from 10 to 50 cm separates DRAFT ( a = 2 a=2 ) from Brain-Diffuser or the generator ( a = 1.5 a=1.5 ). Within noise, image decoders have higher F-scores at 35 and 50 cm. • View-by-view lifting: three routes lifted view by view. By the change in 3D error, DRAFT views agree more than those of Brain-Diffuser + DRAFT layout, but the two look alike by eye. • Duration and lag: the F-score of DRAFT rises from 0.445 over 6 views to 0.595 over 30, so no best duration can be identified. The change in 3D error grows with lag while the methods converge. At eight views DRAFT has a lower recall than the generator. • Historical rows: before the loss correction, the generator had a lower eight-view F-score at a = 1 a=1 (0.420 against 0.469) but its views agreed more (one-second change 0.441 against 0.585 m), and the change of DRAFT was the same (0.372 m). • Registration drift, all conditions: registration drifts shift means by < 0.2 <0.2 percentage points and 2 mm. • Per-scene neural controls: aligned brain input gives a higher layout r r and F-score in all ten scenes under both neural controls. • Equal-scene-weight matched cohorts: an equal-scene-weight variant of the matched cohorts gives a similar result. • Penalty ablation: without the penalty DRAFT has a slightly higher layout r r and a slightly lower pixel MAE, with the same range ratio. • Per-scene uncalibrated ( a = 1 a=1 ) rows: DRAFT has a lower F-score and a higher Chamfer distance than the generator in all ten scenes. • Surface atlas of the ten atlas routes: failures included, with the scores of Table 9 . DRAFT has the lowest route F-score of three methods in seven of the ten routes. • Depth atlas of scenes 5 to 10: DRAFT has the highest route layout r r of three methods in scenes 5, 6 and 9, and Brain-Diffuser + DRAFT layout in scenes 7, 8 and 10. • Noisy-path checks: with re-matched pooling partners the gain over feature replacement stays positive. Under cumulative drift DRAFT falls from 0.473 to 0.412 while its gain over the trajectory head grows. Heads refitted on equally noisy paths recover most of the loss, with a gain (0.055) no larger than under test-time noise, and the refit left the training brain inputs unperturbed. • Design settings and secondary intervals: the 300 design settings; intervals of the 24 secondary contrasts of Appendix I . • Secondary results: a fit on k ≤ 6 k\leq 6 recordings predicts the held-out k = 12 k=12 value within 0.0002. Much of the brain component is shared by videos with the same camera path (added after the result). Against the hypothesis, path coverage is positively associated with the gain over the circular shift and over a layout-only version (unadjusted p = 0.035 p=0.035 and 0.010, neither surviving correction). Five other path measures, the gain over the trajectory head and a per-cell version show no detectable association. A second per-cell version, added after the result, points toward the hypothesis (unadjusted p = 0.047 p=0.047 ). • Withheld scene W1: every arm and style of W1. The readout’s gain in code similarity is slightly smaller (0.192 against 0.219), and DRAFT has a higher precision but a lower recall than the generator. • Shaking-camera style of W1: DRAFT beats feature replacement and the fixed template there, but not the trajectory head. • W2 to W5: route counts, and two secondary results of W5 against the development pattern (the direct readout below its camera-only version, and a negative gain in code similarity). • Layout-code ablation (post hoc): by the planned rule the wall distances, floor extents and opening shares each carry the brain’s gain, the median and spread of depth do not, and no group is necessary. The gain raises the left-right correlation across views ( + 0.039 +0.039 , unadjusted) but not row order.
